title_original: Alan Shearer’s Premier League predictions including Man Utd vs Man City
body_original: Shearer previews another stacked weekend of action (Picture: Getty Images) Alan Shearer is back with his latest round of Premier League predictions with the Manchester derby taking centre stage this weekend. Manchester United host Manchester City with Enzo Maresca ’s side picking up three wins from three under their new head coach. It’s been a slower start for Michael Carrick , dropping points last time out against Everton . Arsenal ’s defence of their title has got off to the perfect start with their mean defence picking up from where they left off. Sunderland await under the lights on Saturday night. Chelsea fell just short at the Emirates last time out but will look to get back on track at home to Hull City. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. As ever, England legend and Betfair ambassador Alan Shearer has revealed his Premier League predictions to Metro . Aston Villa vs Nottingham Forest I remember Villa having a poor start last year, didn’t they? I think they didn’t win in five last year. There was no panic, so there’s no panic again. But I would fancy them to win and take all three points against Forest this weekend. Villa are without a win this season (Picture: Paul Currie/Shutterstock) They had a big win in Europe, A massive win to get three points away from home, and start their Champions League campaign, that was huge for them. Because I think maybe eight points or nine points got you into the playoffs last year, 16 got you into the top eight in the Champions League. So, with all that I would think they would get the three points this weekend against Forest. Forest need a win as well. I thought they were very good against Liverpool, but I still think Villa will beat Forest this weekend. Prediction – Aston Villa win Betfair Predicts: Aston Villa: 42% Draw: 29% Nottingham Forest: 29% Bournemouth vs Brentford Bournemouth should have been three or four up against Newcastle in that first half, albeit they got two deflected goals. The one thing and the one worry I would have for Bournemouth is because they go at you hard for 60 minutes, I just thought for the last half hour they faded. It’s been a promising start for the Bees this season (Picture: Getty Images) It’s very difficult to keep that pace up, the pressing and what have you, and how they do it. They do it really well though. And for the first hour I think they look really fit. Then they run out of steam, and they’ve conceded late goals all the time, which has really hurt them. I do think in this game they’re evenly matched and that’s why I’m going to go for a draw. I think it’s tough to choose a winner between them. Prediction – Draw Betfair Predicts: Bournemouth: 39% Draw: 27% Brentford: 35% Chelsea v Hull If I’d have said to you before a ball was kicked that Hull be the only team in the 92 not to concede a goal in the league so far this season, you’d have laughed at me. Great credit to them and they have been brilliant. I do think that will end this weekend. I think Chelsea will beat them and they could score three or four. Chelsea out to bounce back from Arsenal defeat (Picture: REUTERS) Looking at Chelsea’s form, they are brilliant going forward but you can tell they’re going to concede as well. Alonso has still got issues to work out defensively. But in terms of going forward, particularly with those three, there’s not many better up top than those three and they will always cause you problems and always score goals. Their issue is stopping them at the other end. Hull can frustrate them on Saturday, but I think they’ll have enough to beat them. Prediction – Chelsea win Betfair Predicts: Chelsea: 80% Draw: 14% Hull: 7% Crystal Palace v Ipswich Ipswich had a good start when they beat Sunderland the first day of the season, but we have not seen a lot from them since. Palace had a great win against Fulham. They had to win, they had to get something out of that game, Palace. Otherwise, we would have been talking like we are about Fulham, about Palace. I think it’s important they carry on the momentum. So, I think Palace will have enough to beat Ipswich. I think it’s a big game for both clubs. When you look at what Palace did last week and getting the points against Fulham, I think they’ll look at this game again, particularly being at home, as another game that they could pick up three points. It’s a big game. So yeah, I think Palace will beat them at home. Prediction – Crystal Palace win Betfair Predicts: Crystal Palace: 51% Draw: 25% Ipswich: 24% Liverpool v Fulham I think Liverpool should win this and they will do. They got a good result in Europe on Wednesday, but they do have defensive issues again but being at Anfield I think they’ll have enough to beat them. It’s really important Isak stays fit for Liverpool. It’s really important he keeps up that form he has started in. It’s exactly what he needed personally to have a good start after what happened last season for him and for Liverpool. Isak at the double last time out (Picture: Action Images via Reuters) I said before a ball was kicked, I was slightly concerned with Palace, with Fulham, one or two others. So, I’m not really surprised to see Fulham start the season like they have. Arbeloa needs to win and quickly. If he doesn’t, then you know what’s going to happen. I think there’s two games left before the international break in the league. So, Fulham need to get something in those two games. Prediction – Liverpool win Betfair Predicts: Liverpool: 68% Draw: 19% Fulham: 14% Tottenham vs Everton It was a brilliant strike from Maitland-Niles, and a good comeback for Everton against Man United last week. Clearly it doesn’t take away the issues they’ve got in terms of their forward positions and the numbers that they’ve got in the squad. But that was a big point for them last week against Manchester United. Spurs are desperate to get a win and score goals. It’s a tough one to call this one. I’m gonna go for a draw. Prediction – Draw Betfair Predicts: Tottenham: 47% Draw: 27% Everton: 27% Sunderland vs Arsenal Arsenal are very solid, they’re strong in every position. Sunderland got a good point away at Brentford last week, but I think Arsenal will have too much for them. I think Arsenal will have too much for most teams this season. So, I am going for Arsenal to win and continue their strong start to the season. Prediction – Arsenal win Arsenal already in fearsome form (Picture: Matt Impey/Shutterstock) Betfair Predicts: Sunderland: 12% Draw: 23% Arsenal: 66% Coventry vs Brighton I was really impressed with Coventry last week against Man City. They were really unlucky to come away with nothing. They can take a bit of confidence from that performance. I am going to go for them to get their first point. Brighton will come to Coventry looking to get something, but I think it will only be a point this weekend. Prediction – Draw Betfair Predicts: Coventry: 24% Draw: 25% Brighton: 52% Manchester United vs Manchester City It’s not ideal that Man United played in Europe on Thursday and City played on Tuesday, but you can’t ever use it as an excuse. That’s what they played for last year is to get into the Champions League. So, there’s no point in moaning that you now play on a Thursday and a Sunday. But I do get that they would want a level playing field with City playing on Tuesday. Sesko hoping to start against City (Picture: James Gill – Danehouse) Man United always give a bit extra in the big games. But now we’ve seen them against Hull, we’ve seen them against Everton last weekend, showing just how sloppy they were defensively. It’s a brilliant goal from Ainsley Maitland-Niles, but again I think they always pull something out of the bag for games like this. So I’m going to go for a draw and a point apiece. Prediction – Draw Betfair Predicts: Man United: 30% Draw: 25% Man City: 46% Leeds vs Newcastle It’s always a ferocious atmosphere at Elland Road. It’s only down the road really, an hour and a half down the road from Newcastle, so there’ll be thousands of fans travelling down there. Elland Road’s a great atmosphere. I’m going to go for a Newcastle away win and I hope the boys can keep this good run going. title_original: Lionesses legend Jill Scott handed new job at EFL club
body_original: Jill Scott has been appointed chief women’s football advisor by Salford City. The former England midfielder is set to work with the women’s first-team and academy at the Ammies. Scott has made a return to football with League Two Salford Getty It marks a return to football for Scott following her retirement in 2022. The 39-year-old has since launched a media career which includes punditry on The Overlap alongside Gary Neville , Jamie Carragher, Roy Keane and Ian Wright. She has now joined Salford , who are owned by a group which includes Neville and David Beckham . Whilst the men’s first-team play in League Two , the club’s women’s side are in the sixth tier of English football. Salford City Lionesses have won their opening two matches of the season in the North West Women’s Regional League Division One Central. Their first match following Scott’s arrival as an advisor comes at home to Bury on Sunday. Scott joins Salford City Speaking to the club’s media channels, she explained : “I’m incredibly excited to be stepping into this new role, helping to drive the Lionesses forward and achieve our powerful ambitions. “With the backing and knowledge of AIG, and a team of passionate, talented people at Salford, I have no doubt that the years ahead will be some of our most memorable yet.” In addition to Scott’s appointment, Salford have also welcomed investment from AIG. The American insurance firm have become the Lionesses’ largest minority equity investor. Neville and Beckham joined forces to help propel Salford up the English divisions Getty AIG’s executive vice chairman Ed Dandridge has hailed the arrival of Scott, adding: “We applaud the appointment of Jill Scott as chief women’s football advisor for Salford City. “Jill is an incredibly decorated player and trailblazer in professional football who will serve as a tremendous source of technical instruction and inspiration to Salford City’s women’s and men’s teams as we move forward together on this exciting journey.” Scott’s playing career As a player, Scott won 161 caps for England, scoring 26 goals for the Lionesses. She was part of the side which won the Women’s Euros in 2022 , going viral for an X-rated tirade at Germany’s Sydney Lohmann . Scott was also in the squad which reached the final of the Women’s Euros in 2009 and the England side which finished third at the 2015 Women’s World Cup in Canada. Her career included eight major tournament finals with the Lionesses as well as two Olympic Games as part of Team GB. Salford City Lionesses currently play in the sixth tier of English women’s football Shutterstock Editorial At club level, Scott won nine trophies across her time at Everton and Manchester City , including a Women’s Super League title in 2016. The Sunderland-born star also had spells with the Black Cats and Aston Villa during her career.

title_original: Barcelona make huge Anthony Gordon transfer move after 'not normal' debut in Champions League
body_original: Barcelona have reportedly postponed a payment over Anthony Gordon amid his strong Champions League debut for the club. Gordon has had an incredible start to life at the Blaugrana, with five assists in as many games after his £69 million transfer from Newcastle. The England international came off the bench for his first Champions League appearance as the La Liga champions blitzed Feyenoord 5-1 at the Nou Camp. Gordon entered the fray in the 63rd minute, replacing goalscorer Karim Adeyemi at 3-1 after he and Raphinha bagged the goals. Lamine Yamal and new signing Gabriel Jesus got in on the act to complete the scoring. The addition of Gordon, which came at the expense of compatriot Marcus Rashford, already looks to be a fine bit of business and Barcelona fans have taken to him immediately. However, a new report from El Desmarque claims that Barcelona have changed the way in which the payments will be structured. READ MORE: Anthony Gordon has everyone in agreement over what he did on 'not normal' Champions League debut Barcelona, whose financial struggles have been well-documented, set up an arrangement where they would pay £18.88 million and then the remaining amount. However it's claimed that it has now been agreed to change postpone the first short-term payment until June 2027 - a year on from when it was initially due. The move appears to one made in order to balance Barcelona's financial debts. It has been reported that they owe £77.3 million in relation to new signings, having also paid £51.5 million to bring in Rodri from Manchester City and Karim Adeyemi for £18.9 million as their other significant signings. Football finance expert Kieran Maguire gave insight into the situation, taking to X to comment: "It’s the date of the transfer of Gordon’s registration that determines when the profit is booked, not the date the cash is (not) paid". Anthony Gordon's experience in Barcelona described as 'not normal' Gordon, the 13th Englishman to play for Barcelona, has already been a revelation for the Blaugrana. He has followed in the footsteps of both Gary Lineker and Marcus Rashford but the love from the Barcelona faithful feels different. When he was brought on against Feyenoord, fans erupted in chants for the former Everton star. READ NEXT: Anthony Gordon's reaction to being substituted goes viral after record-equalling Barcelona display The song was also heard during a break in play in the 5-2 win over Rayo Vallecano and he was responded by tapping the badge on his chest in a gesture the fans loved. According to Pol Ballus from The Athletic , Gordon's new teammates made "it clear to him that this is not normal" when it comes to the chant and that "normally, your name being sung by the Camp Nou crowd is a privilege you have to earn". Barcelona return to action on Sunday when they travel to Levante in La Liga.

title_original: Dejan Kulusevski Spurs return update given after 477 days out with specific games set as target
body_original: Dejan Kulusevski is finally nearing a return to action after a injury nightmare totalling 16 months, his international manager Graham Potter has confirmed. The Sweden international has not played since May 2025 after suffering a knee injury, which ultimately caused him to miss the entirety of last season. He returned to first-team training with Spurs at the beginning of September, and Potter has stated that he is hopeful of being able to call the 26-year-old up to the Sweden squad for the upcoming international break. When Dejan Kulusevski could return to football revealed Sweden will contest four Nations League matches as part of an unusually elongated international break, which runs between September 21 and October 6. They face Romania at home on September 25, before hosting Poland on September 28. Two away fixtures then follow against Bosnia and Herzegovina (October 2) and Poland (October 6). Given he is not yet under consideration for a Spurs comeback under Roberto De Zerbi , Potter says Kulusevski is 'very close' to a return - and wants to reach an agreement with Spurs' medical staff for him to feature in the above fixtures if he is passed fit to do so. Kulusevski watched the 2025 Europa League final wearing a protective boot (Image: Getty) "He's very close. I'm so impressed with him, how he's handled his injury," Potter told Swedish outlet SVT . "Of course, we have to be careful with him. "I hope he comes with us, but we have to talk to Dejan and Tottenham first. "The importance of getting Dejan Kulusevski into the national team cannot be emphasised enough. He is incredibly important to the team. We love him, his character and qualities. He is a world-class player and it helps enormously to have him around." Dejan Kulusevski's complex knee injury explained Kulusevski underwent surgery on his a right patella injury at the end of the 2024/25 season, with it initially being expected that he would be out for several months. His absence continued as last season wore on, however, with the lack of updates on his condition leaving Spurs fans concerned. The 26-year-old had further surgery in March, but did not return to fitness in time to play a part in this summer's World Cup. In May, following the nation's World Cup squad announcement, Sweden's team doctor Jonas Werner explained the complexity of Kulusevski's injury and exactly why it had taken him so long to recover. "He hasn't played football in a year, but even the medical assessments made this spring have pointed in the direction that he wouldn't be ready [for the World Cup]," Werner said, as per Fotbollskanalen. "Cartilage injuries, like in Dejan's case, are troublesome. They are difficult to treat. Plus, he has it in a place that gets a lot of stress. The injury simply hasn't healed enough to handle that stress." Following Spurs' 0-0 draw away to Nottingham Forest on Saturday, manager De Zerbi said Kulusevski had suffered a 'small, small problem' on his return to training but was still making positive strides in the final stages of his recovery. title_original: Atletico Madrid player banned from playing Liverpool in Champions League due to bizarre rule
body_original: An Atletico Madrid player has been banned from facing Liverpool in the Champions League due to a bizarre rule. Liverpool get their Champions League campaign underway on Wednesday night as they welcome European rivals Atletico Madrid to Anfield. Julian Alvarez is among the big-name players set to feature in the match, but one of his Atletico Madrid teammates has been banned from featuring in the match due to an unbelievable situation. READ MORE: CBS Sports studio left in stitches as Jamie Carragher makes cheeky reference to bankruptcy issues The bizarre rule that has banned Arnau Ortiz from Liverpool v Atletico Madrid With the likes of Man City, Real Madrid and Aston Villa all picking up wins in their opening matches on Tuesday, the pressure is on Liverpool and Atletico Madrid to pick up a win in their clash. It therefore is a major blow to Liverpool that star winger Cody Gakpo, who has started the season in fine form, missed training earlier in the week, albeit as a precaution. But Liverpool aren't the only side without a star player for the fixture, as Atletico Madrid manager Diego Simeone was forced to leave left winger Arnau Ortiz out of his travelling squad for the trip to Anfield. Ortiz has featured in three of Atletico Madrid's four La Liga matches so far this season and, although he is fully fit and able to play, he has been ruled out of the Liverpool clash due to a historic ban dating back to two years ago. The incident in question happened when the forward was playing for Polish side Slask Wroclaw in the UEFA Conference League back in in August 2024. During a match against Swiss club St Gallen, Ortiz was sent off after receiving two yellow cards, meaning he would be banned from his next European fixture. However, because Slask Wroclaw went on to lose the fixture and crash out of the Conference League, he has been unable to feature in continental competition, leaving his suspension unserved. Until now, as Ortiz can sit out of Atletico's trip to Anfield to serve the ban on Wednesday night, having joined the Spanish side's reserve team from Slask Wroclaw in September 2025 ahead of being promoted to the first team ahead of the 2026/27 campaign. Simeone will also be without Alexander Sorloth for the fixture, while teenage forward Miguel Cubo has been omitted from the squad. This means that Alvarez, who made his first appearance since the controversial summer transfer saga to a booing away crowd last weekend, is expected to start at Anfield. READ MORE: Liverpool replacement for Alexis Mac Allister has become even clearer after damning comments Liverpool v Atletico Madrid sets up Champions League fixture ban And Ortiz isn't the only one falling foul of a strange ban due to Liverpool's Anfield clash with Atleti, as the match now means that the Reds would be banned from drawing the Spanish side at home next season, should they both qualify for the Champions League again. That's because Liverpool and Atletico Madrid met each other in the exact same fixture last year, with the hosts winning the fixture 3-2. But the fixture will be banned from taking place next season, as a new UEFA rule states that the same specific league phase match cannot be repeated with the same home team at the same venue for three consecutive seasons. Therefore, if Liverpool are to face Atletico Madrid in the Champions League next season, it will be at Metropolitano Stadium, regardless of how the teams are drawn.

title_original: Premier League star crashes £160k Land Rover on residential street
body_original: Sorba Thomas crashed his Land Rover close to Hull City’s training ground (X/@HullCityStats) Hull City midfielder Sorba Thomas escaped unhurt after crashing his Land Rover on a residential street on Friday morning. The 27-year-old’s vehicle, which is worth around £160,000, was pictured upside down with the glass smashed on Millhouse Wood Lane, Cottingham. The crash happened around 9am on Friday, with fire engines and police in attendance. Hull manager Sergej Jakirovic was also pictured at the scene. Hull have confirmed that Thomas was unhurt from the crash on the narrow road which runs alongside the club’s training ground. Speaking at his press conference on Thursday, Jakirovic praised Thomas following his move to the newly promoted Premier League side. ‘I don’t have any doubt about Sorba because he made a difference in the Championship,’ Jakirovic said. ‘He is a left winger and we can use him inside like a left-sided No 10. He knows football. He is very good in delivery and his end product is good. Also, he has very good set-pieces. ‘He is sharp and has speed. Also, in defence, he is very responsible. title_original: Jamie Carragher rates Man Utd Champions League hopes after Sabah win
body_original: Former Liverpool defender Jamie Carragher (Picture: CBS Sports Golazo) Jamie Carragher believes Manchester United haven’t got the quality to be a serious Champions League contender this season. Back in the competition for the first time since 2023, United got their league phase underway with a routine 4-0 win over Azerbaijani side Sabah . Matheus Cunha opened the scoring before a quickfire double from Bruno Fernandes and Benjamin Sesko put Michael Carrick ’s side in full control at the break. Lisandro Martinez made the most of a goalkeeping mistake to get on the scoresheet in the second half as the Red Devils got back to winning ways ahead of Sunday’s highly-anticipated Manchester derby. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. United failed to get out of the group stages during their last appearance in the Champions League, but will look to avoid that fate in the revamped league phase this time around. And while off to an encouraging start at Old Trafford , former Champions League winner Carragher is not convinced that the Red Devils will be serious contenders come the business end of the tournament. ‘Probably not just yet,’ Carragher told CBS Sports when asked if United could contend in this year’s Champions League. Manchester United eased to victory against Sabah (Picture: Getty) ‘Manchester United have been out of the competition for a couple of years, but it’s not even like a couple of years ago they were in it consistently anyway. I think they’ve probably been in it once in five or six years, something like that. ‘So even though they are one of the biggest names in world football, I think once you get back in it for the first time for a while, I think the first target will be to make sure they get through the league phase, and then when you get to the knockout stage, can you get a nice run? Can you almost get to maybe a quarterfinal? Something like that. ‘Now, I’m not trying to be patronising in any way. Manchester United, as I’ve just said, are one of the biggest clubs in the world. ‘But to go into it now with the squad that they’ve got and expect them to sort of do big things and take on other clubs with their type of name, they just haven’t got the quality right now, I think, to go deep into the competition.’ Michael Carrick picked up his first managerial win in the Champions League (Picture: Getty) Thierry Henry, meanwhile, believes a clash with Atletico Madrid next month will give a clearer indication of United’s potential in this year’s competition. ‘That was the perfect game to have at home to start the Champions League and be back in it,’ Henry added. ‘At the weekend, that’s when you can see what that team is, and then after, we can have a confirmation maybe after against Atletico Madrid [in matchday three]. But we will see. ‘It’s too early. It’s very difficult to know. Some players left at halftime. Not everybody started because you play City at the weekend. But look, they played against Sabah, they won.’ Assessing his side’s performance on the night, Carrick told TNT Sports: ‘It’s nice to keep a clean sheet and obviously win the game. Some of the football we played was really good, dangerous on transition. I have to give them a lot of credit, they were difficult to play against. ‘The result looks comfortable, it wasn’t always like that. We just did a lot of good things tonight, which gave us a good result.’ For more stories like this, check our sport page . Follow Metro Sport for the latest news on Facebook , Twitter and Instagram . title_original: Regis Le Bris makes huge Arsenal Premier League claim ahead of Sunderland clash
body_original: Sunderland boss Regis Le Bris (Picture: Hayters TV) Regis Le Bris believes Arsenal are the best team in the Premier League and the whole of Europe ahead of their visit to Sunderland on Saturday. Mikel Arteta ’s side have picked up where they left off last season, winning five straight matches in all competitions, including a 1-0 Champions League victory over Napoli in midweek. The Gunners currently sit second in the table, but face a difficult trip to the Stadium of Light at the weekend as they look to keep their perfect record intact. The Black Cats earned a hard-fought point when the two sides met in the North East last season , but were comfortably beaten when they travelled to the Emirates for the return fixture in February. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. And Le Bris is under no illusions as to the task awaiting his side at the weekend, insisting that Arsenal are without doubt Europe’s best side at this moment in time. ‘I think this season they are flying right now,’ the Sunderland boss said in his pre-match press conference. ‘They are the best team in Europe, they were so impressive yesterday, for example. ‘Five wins in a row, I think, now, so the run is really impressive. What we learned, to be competitive in this kind of game, you have to be yourself, I think. Arsenal have made a perfect start to the season (Picture: Shutterstock) ‘The more with the underdog mentality, with this togetherness, this connection with the squad, the connection with our fans as well, is really important. ‘The intensity till the end, once again, and the flexibility, clarity of the game model, because they are so adaptive, with different strengths, collective, individuals. ‘You have to adapt in real time. I think the first game at home, we started really well, imposing our ideas. We struggled a bit at the beginning of the second half. ‘They were good, really good, to beat our deep press. They were really impressive. And till the end, we found our way to equalise with Brian [Brobbey], which was really good. Brian Brobbey scored a late equaliser when the two sides met at the Stadium of Light last season (Picture: Reuters) ‘Away from home, it was a bit different. A different game. They were relentless. I think it’s the brand of these kind of teams.’ Asked if Arsenal look an even more dangerous side this season, Le Bris added: ‘It’s still early in the season but they look so strong everywhere. On the bench, every phase, sub-phases. ‘They are just the best team in Europe, I think, at the minute. They have good momentum as well. It’s a good challenge and we need these challenges to get better. ‘I think we earned last year the possibility to go again and to embrace it and to enjoy it.’ Sunderland will be without Romaine Mundle and Habib Diarra on Saturday after both sustained injuries in the 1-0 win over Fulham at the end of August. ‘Romaine has a knee injury, which is a shame because he had a good pre-season,’ Le Bris said. ‘We will support him and hope he is ready by the end of the year. ‘Habib is in the middle of his recovery.’ For more stories like this, check our sport page . title_original: Troy Deeney names two Arsenal starters who can still ‘offer more’
body_original: Troy Deeney feels there is more to come from two Arsenal forwards (Picture: Getty Images) Troy Deeney has been impressed by Arsenal so far this season but thinks there are still players in Mikel Arteta’s team who could ‘offer more’. The Gunners have got off to a brilliant start this campaign, winning the Community Shield, their first three Premier League games and now their Champions League opener after beating Napoli on Wednesday night. Captain Martin Odegaard continued his fine form by scoring the only goal of the game in Italy, but Deeney still wants to see more from Arsenal’s other attacking players. He reckons the Norwegian is doing all he can at the moment, but Bukayo Saka and Christos Tzolis still have more they can show. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. The former Premier League striker admits he is nit-picking here, though, given how relentless Arsenal have been in winning games. ‘The one thing that Arsenal will always be under Mikel Arteta is that goal against. Really difficult to score against,’ Deeney said on CBS Golazo. ‘One goal conceded. Four clean sheets already in five games. They’ve got the basis and the foundation to always improve. Bukayo Saka has already scored two Premier League goals this season (Picture: Getty Images) ‘The hard part of being so good defensively solid is, do you then go, “right, let’s kick on and try and score loads more?” But if you do that, you open yourself up for transition, which is what he doesn’t want to happen. ‘They transition on teams better than most in world football. So, I see a freedom and a carefreeness and maybe Odegaard is the epitome of that. But again, really, really, really picky, like the 1 per cent now is, you’d like to see more in the final third. You really would. ‘You feel like Saka can offer you more. You feel like Odegaard is probably the only one who’s raised his game. Tzolis on the left-hand side can offer you more. ‘You just feel like there’s more within it, but they get the job done. They don’t really concede goals and they win and they know how to win. So, fair play to them.’ Christos Tzolis has gone straight into the Arsenal team after arriving this summer (Picture: Shutterstock) Saka and Tzolis have looked in pretty good form so far this season, with the Greek providing an assist for Odegaard on Wednesday, while Saka scored in Premier League wins over Coventry City and Aston Villa. Nonetheless, Deeney thinks they can do more and play with the kind of freedom that Odegaard has been exhibiting. On whether Arsenal look different to last season, the former Watford captain said: ‘I’m not seeing a massive difference. I’m seeing a freedom, like a weight off their shoulders, especially with Odegaard. I think he’s the one who embodies that. ‘Maybe being the captain, if you think back to last year, the start of last year, question marks from legends like Tony Adams saying that Declan Rice should be the captain. There was a real big story and noise swirling around that. But since they’ve won the league, he went to the World Cup , he’s been fantastic. Martin Odegaard has been very impressive early in the season (Picture: Shutterstock) ‘And he started this season now, he’s added goals back to his game because there was a lot of talk about it. A lot of things he did, setting the press off, working hard for his team, runs around a lot, but no real value in assists and goals. And now he’s turned that around.’ Odegaard feels like the whole team is operating on a higher level to last season, having landed the Premier League title. ‘I think we feel different. I think we feel a lot stronger this year and I’ve said it many times,’ the Gunners captain told CBS Sports. ‘I said it also after the season when we finished second, you got to learn from it. You got to take the experiences. ‘And of course it’s the same when you win and it’s a different experience. It gives you different kind of confidence. And I can feel that now in the whole team– we play with a different confidence and I feel like we’re on another level this season. ‘I think it made us a lot stronger and I feel like the team is just growing and growing and we’re getting better and the hunger is there. So that’s great to see after winning that we want to do it again and we want more.’ Comment now Comments Add Metro as a Preferred Source on Google Add as preferred source

title_original: Kevin De Bruyne makes huge Arsenal claim after Napoli’s Champions League defeat
body_original: Kevin De Bruyne after Napoli’s defeat to Arsenal (Picture: CBS Sports) Kevin De Bruyne hailed Arsenal as ‘the best team in the world’ after Mikel Arteta ’s side beat Napoli in the Champions League . The Gunners produced another impressive performance in their Champions League opener in Italy on Wednesday night and looked a level above Serie A giants Napoli . Despite their dominance, it looked as though Arsenal’s wastefulness in front of goal would cost them the three points until Martin Odegaard scored a 75th-minute winner . Arsenal clinched their first Premier League title since 2004 last season while reaching the Champions League final, which they lost on penalties to PSG . Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. Arteta’s side look primed to challenge on both fronts again this season after the win over Napoli extended their perfect start to the campaign to five matches. While disappointed not to get anything out of the game, De Bruyne felt Napoli ‘did a good job’ in their European opener given the quality of Arsenal. ‘Let’s talk about the match,’ a CBS Sports reporter said to De Bruyne after the match. ‘It seems to me that Napoli did a really good game but your opponent is maybe the best team in the world right now?’ Martin Odegaard scored Arsenal’s winner (Picture: Shutterstock) Manchester City legend De Bruyne responded: ‘I agree, they are the champions of England and they lost the last Champions League final on penalties so we know how strong they are. ‘I think we actually did a good job, when we tried to play we had some moments where we created, of course we had to stay low sometimes and in the second half we gave them a little bit too much, we were too deep. ‘But after that we had moments again, it’s an improvement for me from what I saw in the first few games. title_original: Man United should have cashed in on Bruno Fernandes when they had the chance
body_original: Manchester United have made a huge error by not selling Bruno Fernandes this summer. That is the opinion of talkSPORT’s Adrian Durham , who claims the Red Devils have missed their opportunity to land a significant windfall for their captain. Bruno Fernandes registered 21 Premier League assists last season – a new record Getty Fernandes has made a superb start to the season having netted four goals in four matches across all competitions. His latest strike came in Thursday’s 4-0 Champions League win over Sabah FK. His heroics come just weeks after the Portuguese was named PFA Player of the Year for the 2025/26 season. Bruno Fernandes previously offered exit routes from Old Trafford Fernandes, whose contract is set to expire next summer, has long been linked with a move away from the club with credible interest from Turkey and Saudi Arabia. But the 32-year-old has shrugged off all outside noise to consistently deliver for Manchester United . However, Durham took a different stance on United’s talisman and explained his reason as to why he believes the Portuguese star has overstayed his welcome. Adrian Durham explains why Manchester United should’ve sold Bruno Fernandes Speaking to his colleagues and Manchester United fans Alex Crook and Angelina Kelly on the latest episode of talkSPORT’s Fiery Fridays podcast, Durham said: “I know you love Bruno Fernandes and I get it, those numbers were insane in that lazy season he had last season,” “He can be an absolute bully, usually against poor sides. I get your love for him but just hear me out on this. “I think Manchester United made a massive error not selling him in the summer [transfer] window. “You’re probably fuming inside but hold it in for now. Fernandes scooped up a string of major awards last season Getty “Bruno Fernandes has just turned 32, so this summer just gone, Bruno’s stock was the highest it could possibly be. Financially, his worth is reducing and reducing. “His value, according to AI right now, is £35million. His value in the summer – £87m. “On what level of business sense does it make sense to keep a player of that age. He’s never going to do those numbers again. ‘So, United should have sold Bruno in the summer. The Player of the Year award would have inflated the fee even more. United could have got a lot of money for him. “Here’s the thing, we all know they overspent in midfield and underspent in defence. “They could’ve addressed that situation and I know United fans are thinking we can’t do anything without Bruno, panic without Bruno. We all know this isn’t true.” Bruno Fernandes is Manchester United’s talisman and continues to work wonders for his side Getty Durham then explained how United boss Michael Carrick could have catered for the void left by a Fernandes departure. “Bruno has been excellent for United, I get that and fans love him,” he added. “But you can put [Matheus] Cunha at no.10, [Benjamin] Sesko at no.9. [Joshua] Zirkzee, [Mason] Mount – there are others that could potentially be back up no.10s. “I think this would have made perfect sense, a player right at his peak. He’s only going to fall to age 32 onwards. “Those numbers aren’t going to come back, this would have made perfect sense. Manchester United have missed a trick, should have sold Bruno in the summer. Did Bruno Fernandes have opportunities to leave Manchester United in the summer? Chief football correspondent Crook responded to Durham’s claim by reminding him that there were no legitimate offers on the table for Fernandes this summer. Adrian Durham says United have missed their chance at a huge sale “I didn’t see anyone knocking on the door offering £87m this summer. There was some talk of a move to Turkey but I think that was Bruno’s agent trying to get him a new contract.” Crook said. “You have to have a willing buyer, clubs don’t tend to pay that much for a 32-year-old.” Quizzed on whether United should consider handing their skipper a new deal next summer, Crook said: “When Marcus Rashford is still being paid more than him, I think he’s got every right to knock on Jason Wilcox’s door and ask him what he’s doing as director of football and ask him for a new contract.”

title_original: Anthony Gordon has Barcelona fans in agreement after 'not normal' Champions League debut
body_original: Barcelona fans are all saying the same thing about Anthony Gordon after he made his Champions League debut for the club in their thumping 5-1 win over Feyenoord. Gordon came off the bench on 63 minutes with Barca 3-1 up, replacing Karim Adeyemi. He did not score or assist at Camp Nou, but earned significant attention on social media for one specific part of his game that he kept repeating throughout his cameo appearance. READ NEXT: Anthony Gordon's reaction to being substituted goes viral after record-equalling Barcelona display Barcelona fans react to Anthony Gordon's Champions League debut With Gordon on the pitch, Barca made it 5-1 through goals by Lamine Yamal and fellow new signing Gabriel Jesus. Hansi Flick's side therefore scored five goals for the third consecutive game, having defeated Valencia 5-0 and Rayo Vallecano 5-2 in La Liga in their previous two matches. It did not go unnoticed by fans that Barca's performance got even better when Gordon was on the pitch, with many noting his unselfishness in creating chances for his team-mates despite his side's comfortable position in the match. Gordon impressed on Champions League debut for Barcelona (Image: Getty) READ NEXT: Anthony Gordon already given new nickname by Barcelona fans "They should give the MVP to Anthony Gordon, he changed the team's whole vibe when he came on," one fan wrote. "Meet Anthony 'set up' Gordon," a second stated. "Anthony Gordon is incredibly unselfish," a third noted. "Anthony Gordon enters and we start playing so much better," a fourth stated. While a fifth wrote: "Anthony Gordon is strong oh look at that hold up play." Barcelona team-mates tell Anthony Gordon he's 'not normal' One of the most notable points of Gordon's early Barcelona career is how quickly he has adapted to his new surroundings. The 25-year-old moved to Spain from Newcastle for a fee of £69.3 million in June and surprised onlookers by speaking some words of Spanish at his unveiling. Gordon has also, according to Spanish outlet SPORT, been learning Catalan, which is regarded as an 'own language' in Barcelona - the capital city of Catalonia. "Gordon doesn't want to be just passing through Barcelona and has amply demonstrated his desire to adapt to the Barca environment," the report stated. A new report from The Athletic's Pol Ballus has revealed the extent to which Gordon's own team-mates have appreciated his willingness to integrate into his new home city. After Gordon's name was chanted during a break in play in Barca's 5-2 win over Vallecano, the winger tapped the badge on his chest to a loud roar of approval. Fans showed their acceptance of him again against Feyenoord when he was substituted on. "Straight after the match, multiple team-mates went to the England forward and mentioned the chants, making it clear to him that this is not normal," the report reads. "Normally, your name being sung by the Camp Nou crowd is a privilege you have to earn. Gordon has won the fans over quicker than anyone expected when he arrived." READ NEXT: Anthony Gordon has become a Barcelona cult hero already with his latest off-pitch decision Gordon is one of only 13 English players to have played for Barcelona. Only two of those - Gary Lineker and Marcus Rashford - have been part of the Spanish giants since the end of World War II.

title_original: Enzo Maresca praises ‘very good’ Man Utd signing ahead of Manchester derby
body_original: Enzo Maresca is looking forward to his first Manchester derby as a manager (Photo: YouTube) Enzo Maresca has hailed the ‘fantastic job’ Michael Carrick has done at Manchester United and praised one of his summer signings ahead of the Manchester derby. Manchester City head to Old Trafford on Sunday looking to maintain their 100 per cent start to the season and their place at the top of the Premier League table. Though they have not beaten their local rivals at Old Trafford in three years, City will be fancied to win this clash after their impressive start to the campaign. Conversely, United have won just one of their opening three league games and have had two days less to recover for the derby after playing in the Champions League on Thursday. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. Carrick was appointed manager after a successful stint as interim boss following Ruben Amorim ’s departure but some have already questioned how long the former United captain will last in the dugout. But speaking in his pre-match press conference on Friday, Maresca had nothing but positive things to say about his rival: ‘I think he is doing a fantastic job since last season. ‘He took over in a complicated, difficult situation. They finish very well. Maresca says Michael Carrick is doing a ‘fantastic job’ at Man Utd (Photo: Getty) ‘This season, more or less, they’ve started in the same way. He is doing a very good job.’ During the summer transfer window, Carrick focused on rebuilding his midfield, signing Andrey Santos, Youri Tielemans and Carlos Baleba. Santos is a player well known to Maresca through his time at Chelsea, though he only started the Brazilian nine times, thanks in part to the presence of Moises Caicedo and Enzo Fernandez. Andrey Santos has started a game since Man Utd’s opening day defeat at Hull (Photo: Getty) Santos made 24 appearances under Maresca at Chelsea (Photo: Getty) United paid Chelsea an initial £48million for the 22-year-old but he has had a tricky start to his Red Devils career. After starting the opening day loss at Hull, he has been limited to cameos off the bench, with Kobbie Mainoo ahead in the pecking order. But if Maresca is to be believed, Carrick has a real gem in his squad, with the City manager highlighting Santos’ great attitude on the training ground. ‘Andrey is a very good guy, first of all,’ the Italian said. ‘Polite, humble, hard-working. So, all the best to him. I can only speak very good about Andrey.’ For more stories like this, check our sport page . Follow Metro Sport for the latest news on Facebook , Twitter and Instagram . The Gunners have got the new campaign off to a perfect start, winning their opening three Premier League matches and beating Napoli in their first Champions League game of the season on Wednesday. They have conceded just one goal in those four matches with their mean defence picking up from where they left off last season despite the absences of William Saliba and Jurrien Timber. White has been ever-present at right-back this season in the absence of Timber, playing the full 90 minutes in every league match and starting again in Naples. White came off late on in Naples (Picture: Shutterstock Editorial) With Saliba recovering from a back injury, Cristhian Mosquera started against Coventry City and Aston Villa at centre-half alongside Gabriel Magalhaes, forced off with a knock of his own at Villa Park. title_original: Owen Hargreaves claims Man Utd star can become ‘best in the world’ after Champions League win
body_original: Former Manchester United midfielder Owen Hargreaves (Picture: Getty) Owen Hargreaves believes Kobbie Mainoo can become one of the world’s best as Manchester United cruised to victory in the Champions League over Sabah. Back in Europe’s premier competition for the first time since 2023, United eased to a 4-0 win over the tournament debutants at Old Trafford . Matheus Cunha opened the scoring after 27 minutes before quickfire goals from Bruno Fernandes and Benjamin Sesko put Michael Carrick’s side in total control at half-time. Lisandro Martinez made the most of a goalkeeper mistake to add United’s fourth in the second half as the Red Devils strolled to a comfortable victory in front of their own fans. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. With a derby against Manchester City on Sunday, Carrick made a few changes to his side for Thursday’s win, but the United boss kept with his preferred duo of Youri Tielemans and Mainoo in the heart of midfield. After falling out of favour under Ruben Amorim, Mainoo has come back into the fold under Carrick and thrived in the second half of last season as the Red Devils got themselves back into the top four. The 21-year-old had a difficult summer with England at the World Cup, but looks to have put that behind him after his latest commanding performance for United. Kobbie Mainoo started against Sabah on Thursday (Picture: Getty) And former Red Devils midfielder Hargreaves was full of praise for Mainoo, insisting the academy graduate can become the heartbeat of United’s midfield and a world-class operator in years to come. ‘I’ve never seen Kobbie play bad,’ Hargreaves told TNT Sports. ‘Every time I watch him play football, I think, “How can somebody not play this young man?” ‘I just think he’s a fabulous football player. Academy-grown, didn’t cost a club a pound, and when you think about some of the fees that these players are going for. Kobbie Mainoo completed 81/83 passes, 6/6 accurate long balls and 10 passes into final third on his full Champions League debut ⭐️ pic.twitter.com/NK9BIGvc4m — Football on TNT Sports (@footballontnt) September 10, 2026 ‘Obviously, they signed Santos and Tielemans for 85 [million] combined. Baleba was probably 70million. What would Kobbie be worth? It’s worth more than them all. No disrespect to any of them, but I just love his game.’ Hargreaves continued: ‘I think he can do so much, and it only really depends on who he plays with and who plays next to him. But I think Kobbie can kind of do everything in there. ‘You can just pass him the ball anywhere at any time. Technically, just so gifted, glides with the ball. That’s what a Man United midfielder needs to do at all times. Obviously, with Bruno in front of him, whether he plays as a six or an eight, he’s what you build around. Mainoo has thrived under Michael Carrick’s tutelage (Picture: Getty) ‘He’s a star. I think he’s gonna be a superstar. He’s only 21 years old, and he plays like he’s 30. That’s how he plays football in the most stressful environment – just chilled. ‘United have got to find who’s going to be Kobbie’s partner because he’s going to be at this club hopefully for a very long time. ‘I think there’s a potential to be one of the best midfield players in the world, but it’s more about personnel and who plays alongside him to get the best out of his attributes.’ Speaking about Mainoo’s performance at full-time, United boss Carrick said: ‘He’s a fantastic player, I think it’s pretty obvious to see with the way he;s performing, playing that little bit deeper and starting the attacks and having a massive influence on our games. ‘He’s a real joy to have; he wants to learn, he wants to improve and he expresses himself on the pitch. It’s great to see.’ For more stories like this, check our sport page . Follow Metro Sport for the latest news on Facebook , Twitter and Instagram . title_original: Arsenal legend Thierry Henry says Champions League team are ‘unplayable’
body_original: Arsenal legend Thierry Henry (Picture: Getty) Thierry Henry has warned Arsenal about an ‘unplayable’ opponent in the Champions League . The Gunners began their European campaign with a 1-0 win over Napoli on Wednesday thanks to Martin Odegaard’s late goal . Mikel Arteta led Arsenal to the Champions League final last season but then watched his team suffer a heartbreaking penalty shootout defeat to PSG . Arsenal are once again one of the favourites to become European champions after winning the Premier League last season and enjoying a brilliant start to the new campaign. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. The north Londoners have won all three of the opening Premier League games and made a winning start to the Champions League against Serie A giants Napoli . Henry is hopeful his former club can finally lift the Champions League trophy but has warned that the holders PSG are virtually ‘unplayable’. Luis Enrique guided the French champions to back-to-back European crowns and PSG kick-started their title defence with a hugely impressive 6-1 win over Slovan Bratislava. Champions League holders PSG (Picture: Getty) ‘You see how PSG press? They’re unplayable,’ Henry told The Athletic . ‘But it took Luis Enrique a good five to six months to get that team going. ‘People do forget that players need to be coachable. That’s a massive thing that people do not talk a lot about. ‘If you’re a coach and your players are willing to do everything you ask them to do, and they have a tiny bit of quality, you can go places. If they rebel a tiny bit, it can be more difficult. Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta (Picture: Getty) ‘It’s easy to say now that PSG is a good team. When all those guys (including Kylian Mbappe, Neymar and Lionel Messi) left two years ago, everyone thought, “Oh my god, where are they going to go from that?” ‘Then they got Bradley Barcola, and then they got Desire Doue. At that time, you’re not thinking those guys are going to do what they did. ‘But because Luis Enrique is so sound on how he likes to play, they have done it. Do you remember what Ousmane Dembele said? He said, “If you don’t run at Paris Saint-Germain, you’re out”. Simple as that.’ All SIX PSG goals from their opening Champions League match of the season 🔥⚽️ pic.twitter.com/p5G6iQ6cqc — Football on TNT Sports (@footballontnt) September 10, 2026 Arsenal have been installed as the clear favourites to retain the Premier League trophy but Henry wants to see more from Manchester City and Chelsea before making any title declarations. ‘Everyone was like, “Liverpool know how to win. I don’t see how they’re not going to win the title again”,’ Henry said, recalling the landscape ahead of the 2025-26 Premier League season. ‘Two weeks after, it went south for so many reasons. When they didn’t buy anyone, they won the league with Arne Slot. They went on to buy people, they imploded. ‘That’s why when people ask me, “Who is a challenger, who is a contender? Do you think if that player goes there, they can challenge?”, I say, “Hey, we have to wait. Let Maresca work, let Xabi work”. ‘Because I coached. People would tell me, “Thierry, you coached for one minute and a half!” But still, (it is not easy) to put the team together during the Olympics in two weeks; a team that never played together before and will never play together after, to build an identity and a philosophy in two weeks. ‘This is why I say let the coach work. Let’s see.’ Arsenal will look to secure their sixth successive win of the season on Saturday when they visit the Stadium of Light to face Sunderland. title_original: Emmanuel Petit says Arsenal missed out on ‘perfect’ summer signing
body_original: Julian Alvarez is the ‘perfect’ striker for Arsenal, says Emmanuel Petit (Picture: PA) Emmanuel Petit says Julian Alvarez is precisely the type of player that Arsenal ‘need’ up front and would ‘perfectly fit the DNA’ of Mikel Arteta’s team. After bringing their 22-year wait for a Premier League title to an end, the Gunners set out their stall in the summer transfer market by landing Bruno Guimaraes , Christos Tzolis and Ezri Konsa for a combined fee of around £164million. The north Londoners also activated their £35million option to signing Piero Hincapie on a permanent basis from Bayer Leverkusen, while bringing in back-up goalkeeper Illan Meslier on a free transfer. With 24 hours remaining of the window, Arteta confirmed that the club were still exploring avenues to strengthen to their title-winning attack after missing out on a deal for Vinicius Junior . Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. Atletico Madrid striker Alvarez emerged as a top target and reports emanating out of Spain suggested the Argentinian was considering Arsenal after giving up hope of joining Barcelona – his favoured move. However, the English champions did not follow-up on their initial interest with a formal offer for Alvarez and Arteta was left disappointed as the transfer deadline came and went. Kai Havertz has gone on to start all three of Arsenal’s opening Premier League matches, scoring twice and producing an exquisite dummy that led to Martin Odegaard’s winner against Chelsea last weekend. Alvarez was denied his dream move to Barcelona this summer (Picture: Getty) The Argentine would ‘perfectly fit the DNA/’ of Arteta’s Arsenal (Picture: Gardin/NurPhoto/Shutterstock) According to ex-Arsenal midfielder Petit, though, Alvarez remains the ideal player to lead the line at the Emirates – even if a deal for the 2022 World Cup winner remains a pipe dream. ‘Julian Alvarez is the striker Arsenal need. Why? Because he knows the Premier League,’ Petit told BOYLE Sports , who offer the latest Premier League odds. ‘He’s such a talented player. Gyokeres has a major role to play this season, says Petit (Picture: Getty) However, Petit has urged Gyokeres to be patient for opportunities and is confident the attacker could still have a significant role to play over the coming weeks and months. ‘Arsenal will have to hope that Kai Havertz does not get injured but this is not the end for Viktor Gyokeres because he is a warrior. He’s got his own qualities. ‘We know Arsenal wanted another striker to come in this summer and Havertz won’t play every game. ‘Gyokeres will have opportunities to prove his worth and stay at Arsenal.’ Eze is yet to start in the Premier League this season for the champions (Picture: Getty) Another player yet to start in the English top flight this term is Eberechi Eze, who blew hot and cold across his debut season last term. But Eze was given the nod from the off against Napoli in the Champions League on Wednesday night and Petit has called on the England international to ‘win his place’ in Arteta’s starting XI. ‘The next step for Arsenal is keeping the same standards, the same ambition, the same ego and humility and players like Eberechi Eze are important to Mikel Arteta for that,’ the 1998 World Cup champion said. Arsenal travel to the Stadium of Light to lock horns with Sunderland this weekend (Picture: Getty) ‘Rotation will be key to his season and we saw what happened last season with the depth of the squad and the options off the bench, and Eze is one of those options at the moment, but there are many, many games to play. ‘The fact that Arsenal have so many players who can set these high standards at the start of the season can send a message to the rest of the dressing room. If you want to play, you have to be really good. ‘If Eze wants to play, he has to win his place. If he can win his place, he will keep the standards high.’ Arsenal have won five from five in all competitions this season (Picture: Maffia/NurPhoto/Shutterstock) On the evidence of Arsenal’s first few performances in the Premier League, Petit is confident Arteta’s men – captained by a resurgent Odegaard – can go out and successfully defend their title. ‘We will hear everything from these people who want to criticise Arsenal for whatever they do. Set piece team?! They are now playing very well, and with full confidence,’ he continued. ‘They have improved as a team. We saw how they broke through the lines, and it is like the glass ceiling over the team has been shattered. ‘Winning that first title was so important for Arsenal and now they can win the title many more times over the years to come. ‘We can see from the start of this season that they are playing with so much belief that they will win the Premier League again.’ Arsenal return to top-flight action against Sunderland at the Stadium of Light this weekend, their second of four straight away matches in all competitions. The Gunners were held to a 2-2 draw at the ground last season before putting three unanswered goals past the Black Cats on home soil. For more stories like this, check our sport page . title_original: Why six Champions League games are taking place on a Thursday
body_original: Manchester United are one of the sides in action later on (Picture: Getty) The Champions League continues tonight with six games taking place this evening – despite it being a Thursday. While Tuesday and Wednesday fixtures are a traditional part of the competition, games taking place on a Thursday are a less familiar sight for Champions League audiences. This is because UEFA has decided that the first week of the Champions League should be exclusive to the competition, with no fixtures from the Europa League and Conference League taking place. The Europa League’s exclusive week, meanwhile, will take place on Wednesday, September 16 and Thursday, September 17. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. After the exclusive first week, the Champions League will revert back to its usual schedule with games staged across Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Incidentally, the Europa League will also return to its Thursday night programme from the second matchday onwards. Bayern Munich have had to wait until tonight to get their campaign underway (Picture: Getty) Manchester United are amongst the teams who will be playing in the Champions League tonight, with Michael Carrick ’s men hosting Azerbaijani side Sabah at Old Trafford . Elsewhere, Bayern Munich welcome last season’s surprise package Bodo/Glimt to the Allianz Arena, while Champions League debutants Como play RB Leipzig. Tonight's Champions League fixtures 8pm kick-off unless otherwise stated Thursday, September 10 Fenerbahce vs Roma (5.45pm) PSV vs Shakhtar Donetsk (5.45pm) Bayern vs Bodo/Glimt Slavia Praha vs Lens Como vs RB Leipzig Man Utd vs Sabah What about the early kick-offs? The opening round of fixtures consists of six games starting at 5.45pm, and the early matches will continue to be a part of the Champions League schedule throughout the season. The early kick-off time was introduced by UEFA for its club competitions in 2021 in an attempt to boost international viewing figures for matches. The move hasn’t been universally popular, however, with one common complaint being that fans commuting home from work often miss the start of the match on TV. The early start also leaves little time for match-going supporters to reach the stadium on time after work – and not to mention the fact they are often travelling during peak public transport times. title_original: Amanda Staveley breaks silence on West Ham saga and insists this isn’t over yet
body_original: Amanda Staveley has expressed her ‘disappointment’ at PCP Capital Partners’ failed attempt to invest in West Ham United. The British business executive, alongside husband Mehrdad Ghodoussi, was keen on a return to football having spearheaded the Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund takeover of Newcastle United in October 2021. Amanda Staveley and Mehrdad Ghodoussi saw their efforts to invest in West Ham foiled Getty West Ham have seen substantial change in recent years with Daniel Kretinsky playing a more influential role in the boardroom since his investment in 2021. In a statement released on Friday, Staveley revealed that PCP’s original offer ‘was for both David Sullivan’s 38.8 per cent stake and Vanessa Gold’s 25 per cent stake’ in the Championship club. But the pre-emption process that provided Kretinsky the opportunity to match PCP’s offer has now been accepted . Therefore, Kretinsky and Sullivan will retain majority control of West Ham. And while Staveley, who co-owned Newcastle between 2021 and 2024, openly revealed her disappointment at the outcome, her ambitions for the club remain open. What did Amanda Staveley say about PCP’s failed takeover of West Ham? “We are obviously disappointed not to have been successful in our bid to acquire the 25% shareholding in West Ham United ,” Staveley said in a statement. “For transparency our original offer was for both David Sullivan ‘s 38.8% stake and Vanessa Gold’s 25.1% stake in the club. “There was always the potential that the other shareholders would take up their rights under the shareholders agreement which is what they have elected to do. “From the outset we and our global investment partners approached this opportunity with enormous respect for West Ham, its history, identity and most importantly loyal and committed supporters. “We saw real potential to make a positive difference, rejuvenate the club and help West Ham compete consistently at the highest level of English football. Czech businesman Daniel Kretinsky is set to become the majority owner at West Ham Getty Kretinsky and David Sullivan will retain majority control of the Championship club Getty “Mehrdad and I along with our partners retain the greatest respect for the West Ham community who supported us both in the stands and online in recent weeks. “We will continue to follow this process closely. Our ambitions for the club remain and we would be open to the opportunity to work constructively with the existing shareholders in the future subject to use not taking up other opportunities that have been present to our consortium in the week of events over the past week.” The outcome may come as a huge disappointment to sections of the club’s fanbase who have grown disillusioned with the ongoing ownership saga. There were also promises of significant investment in the squad this summer that failed to materialise. But the much-needed conclusion to the tale has been welcomed by the Hammers’ Fan Advisory Board who hope the decision will create stability at the club. “The West Ham United Fan Advisory Board welcomes the announcement confirming the significant change in the Club’s shareholding and Daniel Kretinsky becoming West Ham United’s largest individual shareholder,” its statement read. West Ham’s Fan Advisory Board have called for stability at the club Getty “After a prolonged period of uncertainty, we hope this represents an important moment of stability and the beginning of a new chapter for our Club. “We particularly welcome Daniel Křetínský’s acknowledgement of the responsibility that comes with his position and his commitment to communicate further with supporters once the transactions are complete. “Change of control must now mean change of direction. We also look forward to clarity around the role David Sullivan may or may not play outside of being a shareholder. “He resigned from the board and we would hope that position remains the same going forward. “West Ham United supporters have demonstrated extraordinary loyalty to this Club, including more than 50,000 committing to season tickets following relegation. They now deserve to hear a clear, ambitious and credible vision for the future. “That vision must explain how West Ham intends to return to the Premier League and establish itself there sustainably; the strategy for football, recruitment and the Academy; the future of the London Stadium and matchday experience; and how supporters will be genuinely placed at the heart of the Club. “The FAB has consistently called for West Ham United to be run as a modern, professional and ambitious football club, with experienced executives empowered to manage its day-to-day operations and clear strategic leadership from the Board. We now have an opportunity to continue to make that a reality. “The FAB welcomes this new chapter and wishes Daniel Křetínský and the Club’s leadership every success. “The uncertainty must now give way to stability. The change in ownership must be followed by clear leadership. And very soon, supporters must be shown the vision for the West Ham United we are all trying to build.”

title_original: Man Utd dealt blow as details of Lewis Hall’s Newcastle contract are revealed
body_original: Lewis Hall’s new contract will keep him at Newcastle until 2031 (Photo: Newcastle United) Manchester United ’s chances of signing Lewis Hall have taken a huge blow as details of his Newcastle United contract extension have been revealed. It is no secret that Michael Carrick wanted to sign a new left-back during the summer transfer window, with Hall emerging as his top target. The 22-year-old has developed into one of the Premier League ’s best full-backs since leaving Chelsea for St. James’ Park three years ago. His efforts have helped Newcastle win the Carabao Cup and qualify for the Champions League , though he was surprisingly left out of the England squad for the 2026 World Cup. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. The Magpies repeatedly told the Red Devils that Hall was not for sale at any price this summer , but it was reported that the defender was very much open to moving to Old Trafford . That no longer appears to be the case however, as Newcastle announced on Friday that Hall has signed a new five-year contract with the club. Moreover, as reported by The Athletic , there is no set release clause in the new deal, strengthening the Magpies’ position and making it more difficult for Man Utd to sign the player in the future. Hall has two assists in the opening five games of the season (Photo: Getty) It was reported that the Red Devils were still very interesting in making a move for Hall next summer, but he will now surely command a premium price tag. Carrick has just one senior natural left-back at his disposal for this season in the shape of Luke Shaw, but Patrick Dorgu did play there in the Champions League win over Sabah on Thursday, and was named Player of the Match. Man Utd face rivals Manchester City on Sunday in the Premier League, while Newcastle travel to Leeds United on Monday night. Man Utd will find it even tougher to sign Hall now (Photo: Getty) ‘I’m absolutely delighted,’ Hall, who has played every minute of the campaign so far, said upon signing his contract extension. ‘It’s a really proud moment. It’s an absolute pleasure to play for this club and to represent the supporters. I know how much it means to them. ‘The fanbase and the support we get here, whether it’s at St. James’ Park or away, it’s the best in the league in my opinion. To be able to bring joy to their faces, it’s a big thing for me. ‘I obviously have a family connection with the club, which is incredibly important to us all. One of the main reasons I play is to make my family proud, and I know how much it means to them to watch me playing for Newcastle United. ‘It’s a really good place to be. It’s really pleasing with how we’ve started the season, especially with the new Gaffer and coaching staff coming in, and I think we can go on to achieve really big things.’ For more stories like this, check our sport page . title_original: Mauricio Pochettino makes Mikel Arteta claim and Arsenal Premier League prediction
body_original: Former Chelsea and Tottenham manager Mauricio Pochettino (Picture: Sky Sports) Mauricio Pochettino believes Mikel Arteta is the best coach in the Premier League as he named his title favourites for this season. Arteta has transformed Arsenal ’s fortunes since he was appointed as Unai Emery ’s replacement in December 2019. The Spaniard led the Gunners to three successive runners-up finishes in the league before finally getting over the line last season to win the club’s first title in 22 years. The defending champions strengthened in several areas over the summer and have made a perfect start to the new season, with five straight wins in all competitions. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. And Pochettino, who previously managed Tottenham and Chelsea , believes that Arteta’s prowess makes Arsenal the ‘team to beat’ this season. ‘Arsenal are the most consistent team and for me Mikel [Arteta] is the best coach in the Premier League today,’ he told Sky Sports . ‘Knowing what he needs to do, it’s going to be tough to beat them.’ Pochettino was full of praise for Mikel Arteta (Picture: Getty) One of Pochettino’s former teams, Chelsea, have also made a positive start to the season under new boss Xabi Alonso. The Blues suffered their first competitive loss under Alonso last weekend against Arsenal , but bounced back in midweek with an entertaining 6-3 win over Leeds United in the Carabao Cup. Mikel Arteta’s side have made a good start to their title defence (Picture: Getty) And Pochettino is confident that Chelsea’s change in transfer approach this summer can make them league title contenders alongside Arsenal this season. ‘Chelsea are buying players like Rogers, Joao Pedro, Pedro Neto in the past, players in this way that you can expect to fight and be a contender for the Premier League,’ he added. ‘Of course they are disappointed after the defeat against Arsenal, but I think we need to give time to Xabi’s first season after three games in the Premier League.’ Pochettino was also not shy about his desire to one day return to the Premier League, insisting: ‘I have the ambition. My dream now is to be in the USA for four years, but after that, why not? ‘We are still young, and I think coming back is always my goal; to win the Premier League, to be in the Premier League and to build a project with the possibility of winning. ‘I love the football here. I think to have the chance again is one of my wishes and I hope that happens.’ For more stories like this, check our sport page . title_original: Deco explains why Barcelona wanted Anthony Gordon more than Marcus Rashford
body_original: Anthony Gordon swapped Newcastle for Barcelona over the summer (Picture: Shutterstock) Barcelona made something of a surprise move over the summer, signing Anthony Gordon and turning down the chance to keep Marcus Rashford and sporting director Deco has explained why. Rashford was on loan at Barca from Manchester United last season and played a substantial role for them, making 49 appearances in all competitions and scoring 14 goals as they won La Liga. The Spanish giants could have made the temporary move permanent for just £26 million at the end of last season but opted against doing so. Instead they signed Gordon from Newcastle United for around £69m and Rashford returned to Manchester United. Sign up for In The Mixer, Metro's football newsletter Get exclusive analysis and previews of the biggest games every Friday. Sign up now for free. It was something of a surprise move from Barcelona but Deco has offered an explanation as to why they wanted one England international winger and not the other. The former Portugal star was clear that Gordon brings more intensity and energy, which is what manager Hansi Flick was looking for. ‘We are extremely grateful to Rashford,’ Deco told RAC1. ‘He contributed a lot last season, but our idea of play is much more linked to Anthony. His style fits with what the coach is looking for. Marcus Rashford scored 14 goals on loan at Barcelona last season (Picture: Getty Images) ‘We see every training session and analyse the team. We have a clear idea what we’re looking for. One of the areas we struggled last season, without Raphinha, was that the team’s energy dropped. It was lost. ‘We needed more intensity. We analysed a lot of wingers. Signing someone from the Premier League is almost impossible, but [Hansi Flick] was clear with what he wanted and we worked on a deal from there.’ Gordon has already made five appearances for Barcelona, providing assists in La Liga wins over Elche, Rayo Vallecano and Valencia , but is still looking for his first goal. Rashford has returned to first team duties with the Red Devils, starting two of Manchester United’s three Premier League games so far this campaign. Marcus Rashford and Anthony Gordon were England teammates at the World Cup (Picture: Getty Images) Deco also spoke out on another summer transfer saga as Bernardo Silva was linked with a move to Barcelona from Manchester City, but ended up going to Real Madrid. ‘He wasn’t what we were looking for in the end. I love him. He’s one of the best in the world in his position,’ said the Barca sporting director. ‘He wanted to come to Barca, but things didn’t move forward because we have certain parameters. It wasn’t just a financial issue, it was also about playing time. ‘It’s not up to me to say if he is going to play or not, that’s the coach’s decision. But he had a different perception to us after playing [regularly] at City. He wanted to play.’ Comment now Comments Add Metro as a Preferred Source on Google Add as preferred source

title_original: Peter Crouch makes Manchester United vs Manchester City prediction
body_original: Manchester United can ‘hurt’ Manchester City in the derby, says Peter Crouch (That Peter Crouch Podcast) Manchester United’s attack are capable of inflicting serious damage on Manchester City but Enzo Maresca’s side will ultimately come out on top at Old Trafford. Those are the thoughts of ex-England, Liverpool and Tottenham striker Peter Crouch, who has delivered his prediction for what promises to be a compelling derby at the Theatre of Dreams on Sunday. United got off to a nightmare start following Michael Carrick ’s permanent appointment as manager as they were consigned to a 2-0 loss at the hands of newly promoted Hull City in their opening Premier League clash. The Red Devils bounced back with a 5-2 victory over another of the league’s new boys in Ipswich, only to drop more points in a dramatic 2-2 draw away to Everton . Sunday’s thriller on Merseyside would have been especially painful for Carrick given the visitors had twice taken the lead in the contest before throwing away their one-goal advantage. After conceding six times already this season, Carrick will be desperate to somehow plug the gaps in his leaky defence, with his side languishing down in 11th place heading into the weekend’s action. City have won four on the bounce in all competitions following their Community Shield setback and sit top of the table at this embryonic stage of the campaign, above the champions Arsenal on goal difference. Carrick’s side have picked up four points from their first three matches (Picture: Getty) Haaland has scored five goals in all competitions this term (Picture: Images/NurPhoto/Shutterstock) Giving his thoughts on United’s chances ahead of the Manchester derby, Crouch said on That Peter Crouch Podcast : ‘I think it might be the catalyst for them really. ‘I know City have won all three but I don’t think they’ve been in top form and I think United can hurt you.
