title_original: ‘Like I volleyed his cat’ – Nathan Jones calls out ‘arrogant’ official in classic interview
body_original: Charlton boss Nathan Jones has been left mystified by a linesman’s ‘arrogance’ following a controversial decision in Wednesday’s 0-0 draw with QPR. The Welshman has declared that Bhupinder Gill ‘looked at me like I’d volleyed his cat’ after the flag went up to wipe out Tyreece Campbell’s goal. Campbell was denied his fifth goal of the season as Charlton were held at home against QPR Getty In a game of few chances for the Addicks , the hosts thought they had taken the lead in the 39th minute at The Valley. What was the controversial decision in Charlton’s draw with QPR? A wonderful driving run and pass from ex- Tottenham midfielder Oliver Skipp split the QPR defence. Jamaica international Campbell latched onto the ball, where he calmly slotted home past the onrushing Pierce Charles with a first-time finish from outside the box. But his celebrations were immediately cut short as Gill had raised his flag just moments before the 22-year-old released his strike. With no VAR in the EFL, replays have proven inconclusive to determine whether Campbell was robbed of his fifth strike of the season. However, Jones has been left in no uncertain terms that his side were on the wrong end of an incorrect call. And he failed to hold back in his view of Gill, as he declared he was met with utter disdain when protesting the major talking point. What did Nathan Jones say about the linesman? Speaking to Sky Sports following the full-time whistle, Jones fumed: “We scored the only goal of the game. “And once again… I’m sick of it, honestly, I’m sick of it, on the weekend [during 4-0 defeat at Stoke], I had to put up with a performance from an individual that was… I want to use adjectives, but I can’t because I’ll get in trouble – that was beyond the realm of beliefs. “And tonight, he [Gill] had one decision to make and he gave offside. Jones believes Campbell was onside after he was played through on goal by Skipp Sky Sports But the Jamaica international was controversially adjudged to be offside “They were giving offsides willy-nilly, we had one [offside] in the second half which wasn’t. “And the goal is a great goal, it’s a great ball, it’s a great counter-attack. “It is onside and it has cost us three points, that’s cost us three points. “And then the arrogance of the linesman is mental, because he’s like [scrunching his face while shaking his head]. “He’s looking at me as if I’ve just volleyed his cat. “He’s looking at me as if I have done something and going, ‘Nah.’ Jones was left fuming with assistant referee Gill as he slammed his ‘arrogance’ Sky Sports “And he’s made the biggest error of the night and he’s cost us the game and that is the Championship because the Championship is brutal. “These are good sides, we’re competing with monsters, but we stick at it, the honesty, the defensive resilience we’ve shown, our keeper [Arthur Okonkwo] has had to make one save.” Jones then signed off his rant by saying: “I’m proud of my team, it was a tough game against a really good team. “But we have been cost by one individual.” How have Charlton fared this season? The stalemate lifts Charlton up to fifth spot in the table, with the London outfit picking up 11 points from their opening six games. Having failed to win any of their last three matches, they will be looking to return to winning ways against Portsmouth on Saturday.

title_original: Liverpool fans in stitches at Steven Gerrard’s brutal jibe after Marcos Llorente Anfield pet dog name claim
body_original: Steven Gerrard fired a brutal dig at Everton after Marcos Llorente opened the scoring for Atletico Madrid against Liverpool. The Reds legend was on co-commentary for TNT Sports as his former side fought back to clinch a 2-1 win in their Champions League opener at Anfield. Alexis Mac Allister was the match-winner for Liverpool against Atletico Madrid Getty Goals from Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister gave the Premier League side a hard fought victory in Andoni Iraola ‘s first-ever match in the European competition. Quick-witted Gerrard Liverpool survived an early scare in the clash, as Atletico took an early lead when Marcos Llorente slotted home on 17 minutes. This saw the Spaniard keep up his incredible goalscoring record against the Reds, netting five goals in as many games at Anfield. Llorente’s exploits have caught the eye over the years, with midfielder famously naming his dog Anfield after Atletico knocked Liverpool out of the Champions League in 2020. View Tweet: https://t.co/gbd2hjlxXo It didn’t take long for this to be brought up on commentary during Wednesday night’s clash, with TNT commentator Darren Fletcher reminding viewers of the trivia. On Llorente, Fletcher said: “He actually has a dog called Anfield, based on the fact that he’s scored so many goals here.” And co-commentator Gerrard left Liverpool fans delighted with his quick-witted response, as he quipped: “Might call mine Goodison.” Everton supporters won’t have enjoyed the brutal dig, as the Reds icon reminded them of his Merseyside derby heroics as a player. Goodison Park was of course the Toffees’ home ground before they moved into Hill Dickinson Stadium in the 2025/26 season. Gerrard certainly enjoyed facing off against his local rivals, scoring ten goals in Merseyside derbies in his Liverpool career. Gerrard was quick to remind Everton fans of his dominance at Goodison Park as a player Getty The Premier League icon’s goalscoring record puts him fourth in the all-time goalscoring ranks for the fixture, with only Sandy Young, Dixie Dean and Ian Rush scoring more. And Goodison Park proved a happy hunting ground for Gerrard, who won 16 of his 18 games at the stadium, scoring twice along the way. It was a joke appreciated by supporters on the red half of Merseyside, with one saying on X: “Gerrard saying he’ll name his dog Goodison hahahhahaha.” Another added: “Yerrrrs Stevie Lad.” While this fan cheekily said: “Well, at least Everton got mentioned on a champions league night. I’d say that’s a successful night for them haha.” And this Liverpool fan said: “Haha my captain!!” Liverpool edge past Atletico Liverpool’s current No.8 in Szoboszlai started Liverpool’s comeback Getty This was Liverpool’s most complete performance under Iraola so far Getty Gerrard delighted Liverpool fans with a cheeky dig at Everton midway through Liverpool’s hard fought win, the Reds faithful will have been even happier with how things ended up at Anfield. After Llorente’s opener, Szoboszlai equalised for Iraola’s side on 40 minutes, stroking home after a delightful flick from Ronaldo Aruajo. And the comeback was complete minutes into the second half, as Mac Allister fired Liverpool in front. The midfielder, who recently confirmed Liverpool did not intend to offer him a new contract , let rip with a thunderous strike from just outside the box to put the hosts 2-1 up. This proved enough to seal victory for the Reds, though the result wasn’t completely stress free. £123million summer arrival Bradley Barcola sparked concerns when he limped off just before the hour mark , but head coach Iraola later reassured fans that this was due to cramp.

title_original: Arsenal labelled the ‘best team in Europe’ as Martin Odegaard masterclass inspires huge win
body_original: Former Chelsea defender Scott Minto hailed Arsenal as ‘the best team in Europe’ following a dominant display against Napoli. A thunderous second-half strike from captain Martin Odegaard proved to be the difference on a sweltering Champions League night in Naples. Three of Odegaard’s six Champions League goals have come from outside the box AFP The Norwegian let rip with a first-time effort from just outside the 18-yard box that fizzed away from Napoli goalkeeper Vanja Milinkovic-Savic, capping off a fine move from the Gunners that featured plenty of neat interplay. The stats behind Martin Odegaard’s performance Odegaard’s goal – his first in the Champions League since March 2025 – was the cherry on top of what was a true captain’s display. He was at the centre of everything good for the Gunners as he created the most chances (6), had the most touches (20) and completed the most passes that broke Napoli’s defensive line (5) throughout the contest. But it wasn’t just a one-man show from Odegaard, as the entire Arsenal squad combined to repel a Napoli attack that often looked to strike in transitional play. Crucially, it was another clean sheet for Mikel Arteta’s side, who have now kept 20 in their last 40 Champions League fixtures. What did Scott Minto say about Arsenal’s performance against Napoli? And for Minto, who was on commentary for talkSPORT, he could only wax lyrical about Arsenal’s all-round display. “It’s almost as if Arsenal fans are wanting to be in May really, because they are peaking right now,” Minto said. “I think they are the best team in Europe. They look the most complete team. “There were times in the first half where they did look un-Arsenal-like, where they on the transition were quite open. “But still David Raya didn’t have too many saves to make. One in particular from Matteo Politano and Kevin De Bruyne. And that’s about it really. Arsenal’s win over Napoli preserved their 100 per cent win rate this season Getty “And in the second half, they just absolutely stepped it up and led by their captain, their talisman. “And when he plays and plays well, they’re a special side. No one can complain… the little one-twos, it’s like a conductor in an orchestra dictating the tempo and the pace of the music you’re about to sit back and enjoy. He’s a wonderful player, it’s a wonderful strike. “And really, if anything, the scoreline flatters Napoli.” How does Martin Odegaard’s goal tally this season compare to other seasons? Odegaard’s winner against Napoli continued his dream start to the campaign as he took his goal tally to four. He got on the scoresheet in Arsenal’s 3-0 rout of Manchester City to win the Community Shield before he netted the club’s third of the Premier League season in a dominant opening day win over Coventry City. Odegaard then proved to be the hero for the Gunners in a pulsating 2-1 win over Chelsea last Sunday. Odegaard’s goal against Napoli was his 46th for Arsenal Getty Impressively, he has comfortably surpassed his goal haul for the entirety of the 2025/26 campaign, in which he scored just once. And he is now well on track to beat his tally from the 2024/25 season, where he netted six times in all competitions. Odegaard now switches his attention back to the Premier League, with the Gunners next in action away to Sunderland on Saturday at 8pm

title_original: ‘Get a life’ – Non-league club report individual for impersonating manager and giving bogus offers
body_original: Non league club Gainsborough Trinity is ‘aware’ of an individual is impersonating their manager Russ Wilcox. The individual, while posing as Wilcox, has proposed wage offers and potential transfers to players. Someone is pretending to be Wilcox (left) Getty The Northern Premier League, the seventh tier of English football, and the Football Association have both been made aware of the incidents. FA regulations prohibit direct contact between managers and players, with all transfer approaches required to go through formal club-to-club communications. Gainsborough Trinity CEO issues statement “We want to make it categorically clear that these approaches have not been made by Russ Wilcox, nor have they been made on behalf of Gainsborough Trinity Football Club,” Gainsborough chief executive Matt Boles said in a statement. “We strongly condemn the actions of the individual responsible. Impersonating a football manager and making false representations to players is completely unacceptable and has the potential to cause unnecessary disruption and reputational damage to players, managers and clubs.” Boles also expressed gratitude to managers and club officials who reached out directly to Wilcox after they received an approach from the individual who impersonated the coach. “Finally, to the person responsible: enough is enough,” Boles continued. “Stop impersonating our manager, stop wasting the time of players and clubs across the non-league game and, quite frankly, get a life.” Russ Wilcox’s coaching career at a glance Wilcox has been in charge of Lincolnshire-based Gainsborough since September 2023. He has previously managed Scunthorpe United, York City and Farsley Celtic over the course of a decade. Prior to his managerial career, Wilcox spent time working as an assistant coach under Brian Laws. Wilcox followed Laws from Scunthorpe to Sheffield Wednesday in 2006. Gainsborough reached the first round proper of last season’s FA Cup Getty The pair reunited at Burnley in January 2010, but could not save the club from Premier League relegation at the end of the 2009/10 campaign. How have Gainsborough Trinity performed this season? Gainsborough play in the seventh tier of English football and are currently eighth in the league table, one place outside the Northern Premier League’s Premier Division play-off spots this term. Wilcox’s side have won four, drawn once and lost three times in their first eight league fixtures to sit on 13 points, six behind league leaders Cleethorpes Town. Gainsborough will look to put the off-field drama behind them when they host Avro on Saturday. The club then travels to Leamington on September 19 in FA Cup second qualifying round.

title_original: Dejan Kulusevski update issued after return to full training confirmed
body_original: Sweden boss Graham Potter has revealed Dejan Kulusevski is ‘very close’ to a national call-up. Kulusevski recently returned to full training at Tottenham after 477 days out with a complicated knee injury. Kulusevski missed the entire 2025/26 campaign for club and country due to his knee injury Getty However, Spurs boss Roberto De Zerbi and the club’s medical staff have opted to take a cautious approach with the Swede, who picked up a ‘small problem’ last week. What did Graham Potter say about Dejan Kulusevski’s return? An official return date for Kulusevski has not been specified, but Potter, speaking to Swedish outlet SVT, suggested it could be as soon as the upcoming international break. “He’s very close actually,” Potter said. “I’m so impressed with him, how he’s handled his injury. “Of course we have to be careful with him. I hope he comes with us, but we have to talk to Dejan and Tottenham first. “The importance of getting Dejan Kulusevski into the national team cannot be emphasised enough. “He is incredibly important to the team. We love him, his character and qualities. “He is a world-class player and it helps enormously to have him around.” Who do Sweden play in the international break and when are the games? Potter is due to name his squad for Sweden’s upcoming Nations League fixtures in the coming weeks. Sweden begin the international break with a double-header at home, beginning with Romania on September 25 and then Poland just three days later. Potter has been in charge of Sweden since last October Getty Potter’s side then hit the road, where they face Bosnia and Herzegovina on October 2 before they take on Romania on October 5. When did Dejan Kulusevski last play for Sweden and Spurs? Kulusevski last featured in an international fixture on November 19 in 2024 against Azerbaijan, where he scored twice and assisted another in a 6-0 rout. The Spurs flyer has won 45 caps for Sweden, registering five goals and 12 assists. Although the upcoming international break may prove too soon for Kulusevski to make a competitive return, the door has been left wide open for him to feature for Spurs in the coming months. The 26-year-old was included in Spurs’ 25-man Premier League squad for this season, underlining De Zerbi’s faith in the winger to make a successful return. Kulusevski has not played for Spurs since May 11 in 2025, where he was forced off with injury against Crystal Palace.

title_original: La Champions cierra su primera jornada: el Como debuta a lo grande, United y Bayern golean y el Lens remonta
body_original: La fase de liga de la Champions League 2026-2027 ya ha finalizado su primera jornada. Larga y repleta de partidos, resultados abultados y con algún partidazo, se dejó para el final el regreso a lo grande del United, la primera de muchas goleadas del Bayern y la puesta de largo del Como más español que italiano de Cesc Fábregas. Seis partidos con los que se despide la máxima competición hasta bien metidos en octubre, puesto que también se jugó un Slavia-Lens y, antes, un PSV-Shakhtar y un Fenerbahce-Roma. La jornada comenzaba con dos empates en sus primeros partidos, los del horario vespertino de las 18:45 horas. No son horas para jugar la Champions, debieron pensar los desubicados aficionados del Fenerbahce, a los que se les había olvidado la música de las estrellas tras 18 años de ausencia. En su regreso, 1-1 en casa ante una Roma que también se había perdido en su camino hacia la máxima competición, hasta reencontrarse con ella siete años después. Quien sigue siendo habitual en ella, y tiene mérito, es el Shakhtar. A Eindhoven les llevaba el primer encuentro y allí estuvieron a punto de ganar. Sergiño Dest lo evitó, empatando el partido para el PSV, con un disparo raso en la primera parte, puesto que había adelantado a los ucranianos Gleiker Mendoza. Goleadas y remontada El Como se estrenó en su estadio, el Giuseppe Sinigaglia, tras una obra exprés de la que bien podría aprender algún equipo español para no tener que jugar en el exilio. Y vaya debut. Los de Cesc golearon por 4-1 a un Leipzig que apenas hizo acto de presencia durante unos minutos en la primera mitad, cuando ya caían 1-0. Baturina fue el gran líder de los italianos, donde también destacaron Luis Milla, Nico Paz y Assane Diao, que marcó. Otro cuatro le calzó el Manchester United a la cenicienta Sabah. El majestuoso Old Trafford fue de todo menos un teatro de los sueños para los azeríes, que se fueron superadísimos al descanso, perdiendo por 3-0. Bajaron el ritmo los red devils en el segundo tiempo, donde sólo marcaron un tanto más para regresar a la máxima competición con un 4-0. Y aguantó como un grande el Bodo/Glimt un asedio en Múnich. Eso sí, hasta el descanso. Empataron a cero gracias a la actuación de su portero, que se fue lesionado al vestuario. A partir de ahí, el Bayern sacó el rodillo para endosarle una manita en la segunda mitad, con doblete tardío de Olise. El partidazo se vio en Praga. Allí, el Slavia recibía a un Lens que parece crecido en la Ligue 1 y que, como suele pasar con los clubes franceses, pareció por momentos descomponerse en Europa. 2-1 caían en el minuto 90′ y terminaron dándole la vuelta al encuentro en el descuento para ganar 2-3.

title_original: El Barcelona reniega ahora de Julián: «No le dijimos que expresara su deseo de irse del Atlético»
body_original: El Barcelona reniega ahora de Julián Álvarez y asegura que no dijeron al futbolista del Atlético que expresara públicamente su deseo de marcharse del conjunto rojiblanco. Así lo ha dejado claro Deco, director deportivo del Barça, que ha dicho un rotundo «no» al ser preguntado por ello. « Hemos hecho las cosas bien . Hay más un tema de presión social que de realidad. Le mandamos una oferta (al Atlético de Madrid) y no hubo respuesta», ha dicho Deco, que, tras ser preguntado por si el Barcelona le pidió a Julián Álvarez que dijera públicamente que se quería ir del Atlético, ha dicho que «no». Deco ha insistido en que todo se ha hecho de «forma respetuosa» , algo que no comparte el Atlético de Madrid, y que «no hay que dar más vueltas» a este tema. «Hemos hecho una oferta formal y correcta», ha añadido, a la vez que ha negado que esa oferta fuera en seis plazos: «Fue para pagar en tres temporadas, como hacen el resto». El director deportivo culé, en una entrevista en RAC1 , ha puesto el ejemplo de cuando era jugador del Oporto y el Barcelona le quería: «A mí el presidente del Oporto no me dejó irme al Barça. Me dijo que me quedase un año y luego me dejaría ir. Me quedé y mi obsesión era jugar bien. Por suerte, en mi caso, pude ir donde quería». Estas palabras dejan en mal lugar a Julián Álvarez , que en pleno Mundial con Argentina, soltó la bomba al asegurar que quería irse del Atlético de Madrid. «Lo mejor es una transferencia, quiero cumplir mi sueño», dijo el futbolista argentino. Se entendió entonces -así informaron varios medios de Barcelona- que hacer público ese deseo era una petición del club azulgrana, que le servía como forma de presión para que el Atlético le vendiera. Deco reniega ahora de eso, también de Julián Álvarez y se centra en la temporada actual. Además, sobre el no fichaje de Bernardo Silva , que se fue al Real Madrid, el director deportivo del Barça dice que «no era la posición que buscábamos por perfil» y de Rodri Hernández que fue Flick el que dijo «adelante» y fue cuando se pusieron manos a la obra para ficharle.

title_original: Boxing Day is back: Premier League makes early announcement on Christmas fixtures
body_original: Christmas has truly come early with the Premier League announcing the return of a full Boxing Day schedule for the 2026/27 season. A cherished date in the football calendar, last campaign saw just one game played , which saw Manchester United beat Newcastle 1-0. Premier League fans can get excited for the return of Boxing Day fixtures Getty It was the fewest amount of games to take place on December 26 in Premier League history. Not since 1982 had there been less matches on Boxing Day, and that was only because there were none that year. However, in an early announcement, there will now be seven Premier League games on December 26. What are the Boxing Day games? Boxing Day fixtures for 2026/27 season Aston Villa vs Leeds United – 12.30pm Everton vs Sunderland – 3pm Fulham vs Brighton- 3pm Ipswich Town vs Brentford – 3pm Tottenham Hotspur vs Bournemouth – 3pm Hull City vs Liverpool – 5.30pm Newcastle United vs Manchester City – 8pm The festivities will begin with Aston Villa hosting Leeds in the lunchtime kick-off at 12.30pm. There will then be four 3pm games: Everton vs Sunderland, Fulham vs Brighton, Ipswich vs Brentford and Tottenham vs Bournemouth. Hull will host Liverpool in the 5.30pm game before the day concludes with Newcastle vs Manchester City at 8pm. The remaining fixtures in Gameweek 17 will take place on December 27. Chelsea visit Coventry at 2pm, Nottingham Forest head to Manchester United at 4.30pm and Crystal Palace welcome Arsenal at 7pm. Why was there just one Boxing Day game played in 2025? The traditional set of Boxing Day fixtures in 2025 were abandoned due to expansion of UEFA competitions, while FA Cup matches were moved to take place on weekends. But with Boxing Day this year to fall on a Saturday, the Premier League are able to broadcast a full set of fixtures. Boxing Day football is a tradition unlike any other Getty Fans were left furious by the scrapping of Boxing Day games last year, with the Premier League announcing in November 2025 that they would return to the calendar this term . And on Thursday, they announced their rundown of Boxing Day games – more than a month earlier than they did last year. The decision to go early has reportedly been due to pressure from clubs to allow fans to be given more time to plan, which will minimise any disruption. Meanwhile, the Football Supporters Association have been in talks with those involved for the clashes to be announced sooner rather than later. Gameweek 17 has subsequently been amended before any games dating from November onwards.

title_original: Richarlison in talks with FIFA over drastic action to force Tottenham transfer
body_original: Richarlison has approached FIFA to try and terminate his Tottenham contract, talkSPORT understands. The Brazilian believes he has a case to tear up the final year of his deal after being left out of Spurs’ 25-man Premier League squad . Richarlison may have already played his final match for Tottenham Getty Richarlison is in talks with Vasco da Gama about a return to his homeland. Could Richarlison have left Tottenham in the summer? The 29-year-old had been heavily linked with a return to Everton before the summer window closed. He scored 53 goals in 152 games for the Toffees during his four-year spell in Merseyside between 2018-2022. But he subsequently rejected the chance to link up with David Moyes. He then issued a statement on social media where he referred to Everton as his ‘favourite team’, while slamming Spurs for how they acted during negotiations. And having then been left out of the north London outfit’s top-flight squad, he is now seeking a swift exit away from the club. Richarlison isn’t the first player to take their case to FIFA after being shunned by their employers. Last year, his compatriot Renan Lodi was in a similar situation at Al Hilal, with the full-back left out of their Saudi Pro League squad. He sought out FIFA intervention to rip up his deal to join Brazilian outfit Atletico Mineiro, with football’s governing body upholding his claim. Richarlison, who started in Spurs’ opening Premier League day defeat away at Brentford, could now have played his last game for the club. Brazil international Richarlison has scored 32 goals in 134 games for Tottenham across all competitions AFP What has been said about Richarlison? Reacting to the news live on talkSPORT, former Crystal Palace owner Simon Jordan believes that a dangerous precedent could be set if the forward gets what he wants. He said: “He’s been demoted now to the Under-21s, hasn’t he? “What they’ll be citing is some degree of sporting chance that enables him to have his contract [ripped up]. “I think it would be tragic if they did, because it means that players could do as they want. “They can be dreadful and have no consequence, they can have dreadful discipline, and dreadful behaviour and have no consequence behind it. “FIFA are an adjudication, but if the club haven’t done their job properly and protected their position, and there is a threat here and there is a threat to the contractual status because he’s been demoted to a different space to the contract that he signed, which is obviously a signature for the first team… Richarlison was part of Spurs’ squad that won the Europa League in 2025 Getty “As an owner’s mentality, I would think that’s pretty sad that a player can get away with being an absolute pest.” Jordan was then pressed by co-host Jim White as to whether that Richarlison’s contract being ripped up works best for both parties. To which he remarked: “I’m sure Tottenham wants him to go, but not on his terms. “I’m sure Tottenham realise that, they must have a commercial view on what he’s worth. “They must have an understanding of what it’s worth to get rid of him, because he doesn’t want to be there, and they probably don’t want him. “So what would be the purpose of parking him up, running down his contract, paying his wages and getting nothing for him? Richarlison is into the final year of his contract in north London Getty “So despite the fact I’m not the greatest admirer of those that are running Tottenham Hotspur at this moment in time, I don’t think they’re that silly. “So there is clearly a distinction between the player and his representation, believing they can get exactly what they want, how they want, where they want, irrespective of what makes it work for those that hold his registration. “If that’s the world we are now living in with contracts, pretty soon contracts will be worth nothing.” Referencing Lodi’s case, Jordan then added: “Hopefully the circumstances are not the same, and he [Richarlison] doesn’t get to exploit a loophole. “And if he does, then Tottenham Hotspur are fools and left themselves open to it.” Jordan then urged Spurs to try and keep hold of the player until the January window, before flogging him off.

title_original: How to follow Liverpool vs Fulham: Arbeloa returns to Anfield aiming to succeed in test Gerrard failed twice
body_original: Former Liverpool defender Alvaro Arbeloa returns to Anfield this weekend as his Fulham side take on the Reds. Arbeloa played 98 games for Liverpool from 2007 to 2009, featuring 66 times in the Premier League during that stint. Arbeloa is returning to Anfield as a manager after spending two years there as a player Getty He’s now going to be back on Merseyside, hoping to come out on top against his old side and pick up a much-needed win. Fulham have lost their first three games in the Premier League this season, with boss Arbeloa still waiting on three points. That has the Cottagers sitting 19th in the table heading into this clash, so they will be desperate for a victory. History, however, doesn’t give Arbeloa much chance of glory on his return to Anfield this Saturday afternoon. Three previous Liverpool players have taken on the club as a manager in the Premier League, but none of them have won. Paul Ince was in charge of Blackburn in 2008 when his side were beaten by the Reds, while Mauricio Pellegrino lost twice to his old club when managing Southampton in 2017/18. And most recently, club icon Steven Gerrard lost both of his meetings with Liverpool with Aston Villa in the 2021/22 campaign. Can Arbeloa put an end to that losing streak? He’ll hope to do so, particularly to Fulham’s dismal start to the season . How to follow Liverpool vs Fulham Liverpool host Fulham on Saturday, September 12. Kick-off at Anfield is scheduled for 3pm – which means the game is not available to watch live on TV due to the 3pm blackout. Liverpool welcome Fulham having beaten Ipswich last time out in the league Getty Premier League Matchweek 4 fixtures Saturday, September 12 Aston Villa v Nottingham Forest, 15:00 Bournemouth v Brentford, 15:00 Chelsea v Hull City, 15:00 Crystal Palace v Ipswich Town, 15:00 Liverpool v Fulham, 15:00 Tottenham v Everton, 17:30 Sunderland v Arsenal, 20:00 – LIVE on talkSPORT Sunday, September 13 Coventry v Brighton, 14:00 Manchester United v Manchester City, 16:30 Monday, September 14 Leeds v Newcastle, 20:00 – LIVE on talkSPORT talkSPORT will have all the updates of all the action from Merseyside during GameDay Live with Adrian Durham. Listen talkSPORT through the website or find us on DAB digital radio through your smart speaker and on 1089 or 1053 AM. Download and listen to all our live commentaries via the talkSPORT app, whilst talkSPORT is also available to watch on Samsung TV Plus. Subscribe to the talkSPORT YouTube channel for news, views and analysis plus our regular goals show and for more, follow us on talkSPORT Facebook and talkSPORT on X . For the latest odds and bet boosts for every big event, visit talkSPORT BET. Liverpool vs Fulham: Team news Liverpool still have Hugo Ekitike , Joe Gomez, Conor Bradley, Federico Chiesa and Giovanni Leoni ruled out injured. But Alexander Isak appears to be back to his best following his long injury layoff, scoring twice against Ipswich. He has already scored as many goals as he did last season, looking to now score in a third straight Premier League game for the first time since a streak between December 2024 and January 2025. Victor Munoz could start on the right wing again, with the Spaniard preferred to Rio Ngumoha in the last two games, while Bradley Barcola may be handed his first league start. Isak has been in fine form at the start of the new Premier League season AFP As for Fulham, Tom Cairney is the only injured absentee. Josh King is expected to continue in the No.10 position after scoring two goals in the first three games of the season. But Sander Berge, Emile Smith Rowe and summer signing Hugo Larsson will hope to get a start at Anfield.

title_original: ‘That is criminal’ – Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer have hilarious argument after Man-of-the-Match prize awarded
body_original: Morgan Rogers couldn’t believe that he didn’t get awarded Man of the Match after Chelsea’s 6-3 win over Leeds United in the Carabao Cup. The Blues were trailing 1-0 at half time in their delayed game before Xabi Alonso introduced Rogers, Cole Palmer and Pedro Neto at half time to totally flip the game. In the end, it turned into a great night for Chelsea Getty Palmer scored twice and Rogers grabbed FOUR assists, but it was the former who claimed the Man of the Match award. This led to a pretty hilarious argument live on Sky Sports between the pair. It started with Rogers, who said: “Mate, I got four assists! Nah, nah, I can’t believe that. That is mental. He scored a penalty. That is mental.” Palmer then said: “I started the comeback. But I’ll say you should have had it.” To which Rogers responded: “Don’t mention me. I am just a bystander. That is criminal.” Rogers robbed There is no question that both players had a huge impact on the game even if it wasn’t immediate. That is because Leeds doubled their lead early in the second half through Brenden Aaronson. They had opened the scoring through Tarik Muharemovic’s towering header and were good value for it. But Dan James’ foul on Pep Chavarria in the Leeds box changed everything. Rogers was left absolutely stunned that he didn’t pick up Man of the Match Sky Sports The duo’s banter and off-field relationship appears to be helping on the pitch as well View Tweet: https://t.co/X2PkPnSGDk Palmer stepped up to score a penalty, and he bagged the equaliser soon after. Reece James hurled a throw-in into the box that Rogers flicked into Palmer’s path. The England international wrapped his left boot around it and sent it into the far corner. It was soon 3-2 with Rogers grabbing his second assist after Palmer had played a pass to him. The pass wasn’t quite perfect, so the former Aston Villa man lunged at the ball. He won the 50/50 and sent it through for Neto, who struck a lovely first-time strike off the inside of the far post. The hat-trick of assists came for Rogers as he dribbled down the right and played a low ball into the box. Palmer began the Chelsea fightback, scoring two of their six goals Getty Danny Welbeck controlled, turned and fired it home via a slight deflection. There is definitely the argument to suggest the fourth assist for Rogers might not actually be his. He drilled a low cross in that deflected to Valentin Barco, who lashed home from close range. But even if it doesn’t go down as his, he still definitely got a hat-trick of assists. Alonso’s thoughts It has been an exciting start to life for Alonso at Chelsea with his side scoring and conceding plenty of goals. And he admitted after the game that he got his team selection wrong with nine changes from the defeat to Arsenal. Alonso’s men have been the great entertainers this season, scoring 16 goals in five matches in all competitions so far Getty He said: “Yeah, there was so many changes. There was a risk. “Things weren’t going the way we planned, so we had to change (at half-time). I take responsibility with the first half. “They knew they weren’t starting and they were ready to make an impact. I’m happy with the result and the reaction.” But he is pleased to see Palmer and Rogers linking up so nicely, adding: “For sure, it’s so important. To have a great chemistry between them. They enjoy assisting together. It’s important for the team.”

title_original: Barcelona stadium is the new Old Trafford despite £1.3bn renovation as press box drenched after biblical downpour
body_original: The press boss at Barcelona’s newly renovated Nou Camp was drenched by torrential rain during their recent Champions League win. Barca kicked off their European campaign with an emphatic 5-1 win over Feyenoord in their first league phase game on Wednesday. Raphinha scored his third goal in his last two games against Feyenoord AFP A Raphinha double sandwiched between goals from Karim Adeyemi and Lamine Yamal put Hansi Flick ‘s side in cruise control, before new signing Gabriel Jesus opened his Barcelona account late on. Camp Nou issues laid bare Barca stormed to victory on a rainy night at the Camp Nou, and some inside the ground ended up even more soaked than the players. With torrential rain striking in Catalonia, footage shared online has shown the stadium’s press box being drenched by the conditions. Barcelona’s iconic home has been in the process of a £1.3billion renovation project since 2023, with Barca only returning to play at the stadium in November 2025 after two years away. View Tweet: https://x.com/hashtag/barfey?src=hash&ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw However, certain parts of the venue are still being refurbished, as journalists inside the ground discovered on Wednesday night. One video has been shared on social media showing a stream of water falling through an opening onto the press box. Rain is seen pouring down onto the reporters’ desk, with water lashing off the table and flooding the surface. One journalist is shown retrieving an item from the puddle of water on the table, with the conditions making it impossible for journalists to work on their laptops. Scaffolding can be seen in the press box, making it likely that reconstruction work is ongoing in this part of the Camp Nou. Barcelona’s home ground isn’t the only venue to succumb to the elements. Fans braved torrential conditions at the Nou Camp to watch Barcelona thump Feyenoord AFP Manchester United’s Old Trafford has experienced similar roof leaks in recent years In recent years, Manchester United ‘s Old Trafford home has experienced similar problems , with fans being drenched on more than one occasion as the stadium roof failed to contain the rain. Is the Camp Nou renovation complete? The recent Camp Nou footage comes after Barcelona reportedly ran out of money during their £1.3billion stadium renovation . Work on the venue began after the 2022/23 season, with the Catalan giants eventually returning in November last year. They played at the 55,000-seater Olympic Stadium on the city’s Montjuic hill during most of the construction. But significant work is still required as the club plans to increase the Nou Camp’s capacity to an incredible 105,000. Heavy construction is ongoing on the stadium’s upper tier, with Barcelona currently only able to play in front of a reduced 62,000 capacity. Barcelona’s Camp Nou is one of the most impressive stadiums in Europe Getty Additionally, the final stage is the refurbishment of the roof, with venue’s shortcomings in this area plain to see in Barca’s last match. The La Liga champions have requested to use the Estadi Olimpic Lluis Companys as a temporary home for the 2027/28 campaign.

title_original: Scotland appoint coach who worked under Jose Mourinho at Manchester United on coaching staff
body_original: New Scotland coach Sebastien Pocognoli has rounded out his staff ahead of the upcoming international break. Alan Irvine will stick around as an assistant coach, having first joined the Scotland set-up after Euro 2024. Irvine boasts extensive coaching experience, having managed Preston, Sheffield Wednesday and West Brom Getty Irvine and Pocognoli are no strangers to each other, with the former signing the Belgian during his time in charge of West Bromwich Albion in July 2014. “I am really pleased that Alan didn’t hesitate in agreeing to stay on,” Pocognoli said. “His passion for the role is obvious, as is his quality on the training pitch. He has the respect of everyone who has worked with him.” Joining Pocognoli’s staff as an assistant coach is Luke Benstead. Benstead previously worked under legendary boss Jose Mourinho as a performance analyst at Manchester United. He also boasts experience at international level having spent seven years as an assistant with Belgium under Roberto Martinez and Domenico Tedesco. Benstead joins the Scotland set-up from Turkish club Istanbul Basaksehir, where he was the assistant and set-piece coach. “Luke was known to me from his time in Belgium, where he has worked with some big talents in his seven years with the national team,” Pocognoli said. “He has such a rounded skillset, having worked as a performance analyst then as an assistant coach at the highest level, with that added responsibility for set-pieces, which he will continue with Scotland. His enthusiasm to join this exciting project really stood out.” Cameron Campbell will serve as Pocognoli’s third assistant coach. Benstead experienced the methods of ‘The Special One’ up close Getty Campbell serves as the first team coach at Tottenham under Roberto De Zerbi. He moved to Spurs from RB Leipzig, where he was their transition coach and head of talent. Rounding out Pocognoli’s staff is goalkeeping coach Chris Woods, who has held coaching positions at Everton, United, West Ham and the United States national team. “I have allocated all of the staff very clear responsibilities,” Pocognoli said. “I know they are all looking forward to the forthcoming camp and I am excited to get to work with them.” Who does Scotland play in the upcoming international break? Scotland travel to Slovenia for Pocognoli’s first game in charge, with the Nations League clash scheduled for September 26. Pocognoli is only five years into his senior coaching career Getty Pocognoli’s side then hosts Switzerland on September 29. Scotland round out the international break with a trip to North Macedonia on October 3 before welcoming Slovenia to Hampden Park on October 6.

title_original: Trent Alexander-Arnold handed Real Madrid warning after backhanded compliment from Jose Mourinho
body_original: Trent Alexander-Arnold will not be trusted by Jose Mourinho in Real Madrid’s big games – either in midfield or defence. That’s the view of Chelsea legend Joe Cole, who has had his say on comments made by the Special One regarding the 27-year-old’s performance against Inter Milan. Alexander-Arnold’s future at Madrid under Mourinho has been called into question Getty The versatile full-back started in the middle of the park in Tuesday night’s victory over the Italian giants in their Champions League opener due to Eduardo Camavinga, Arda Guler and Bernardo Silva all being suspended . Despite having played in central midfield for both England and Liverpool in the past, Mourinho has made it clear that it is not a position he excels in. What has Jose Mourinho said about Trent Alexander-Arnold? Speaking about the player following Los Blancos ‘ win, he said: “I thank Trent Alexander-Arnold for his efforts to play in a position that is not his. “It’s very clear that his qualities are made for the full-back position, not for midfield. “He has played midfield with England and Liverpool, but he is not a midfielder, he has played very well, he has interpreted what he needed to really well, tactically.” Mourinho added: “He has lost some balls because it is not the same to play in this position compared to at right-back. “The intensity of physical work is quite difficult, he has a different engine, he has given 100 per cent, he left the pitch with nothing left to give.” Alexander-Arnold has had to compete with summer signing Denzel Dumfries for a starting spot at right-back so far this season. And for Cole , who won two Premier League, one FA Cup and one League Cup under Mourinho’s tutelage at Stamford Bridge, he believes that his compatriot could struggle for minutes as the season goes on. What has Joe Cole said about Trent Alexander-Arnold? Appearing on the Sports Breakfast show to discuss Alexander-Arnold’s situation, Cole remarked: “It’s going to be difficult for Trent. Just two of Alexander-Arnold’s four appearances this season have come from the starting line-up Getty “First of all, I love him, I think he’s an unbelievable footballer, but when it’s a Jose team, I think it usually is defence first, right? It’s stop the back door. “And he’s been tried in midfield as well, I like him in midfield, but there’s being a midfielder and then there’s being a Real Madrid midfielder. “Like Trent, of course he’s going to get played, he’s a genius with the football, he can play anywhere on the pitch. “But to get to the levels that’s needed for Real Madrid to win the league and Champions League, he did OK [vs Inter]. “And Dumfries at the back, them two are not like for like, are they? They’re chalk and cheese. “So Jose, I think, will use him in certain games. Dumfries has quickly endeared himself to the Madrid faithful following his switch from Inter Milan Getty “But I think when the push comes to the shove and they’re playing the big hitters, Dumfries might be the one that gets the nod because he’s more of a defender.” Alexander-Arnold has featured in three of Real’s opening four LaLiga matches this term. However, he has been limited to just one start, which came in the 4-0 win over Malaga – a game which saw him register an assist. The two-time Premier League champion will be hoping to retain his place in the line-up when Real welcome Rayo Vallecano to the Bernabeu on Saturday night.

title_original: La prensa afín a Mohamed VI se mofa de España por la final del Mundial: «¿Harán un gran estadio en la Ceuta ocupada?»
body_original: La prensa de Marruecos afín al régimen de Mohamed VI se mofa de España en la pelea por albergar la final del Mundial 2030. A la vez que Fouzi Lekjaa , presidente de la Federación de Fútbol y ministro de su Gobierno, asegura que la final será en Casablanca , en la prensa se ríen de nuestro país, minimizando las opciones de que España acoja ese partido. Lo hacen recogiendo varias situaciones que han ocurrido últimamente, aunque lo mezclan, en forma de burla, con la invasión que sufrió Ceuta hace ya más de un mes. Así, por un lado, se hacen eco de las goteras que sufrió el Camp Nou este miércoles en el partido de Champions entre el Barcelona y el Feyenoord, riéndose de que ese pueda ser uno de los estadios rivales contra Casablanca por acoger la final del Mundial 2030. En un artículo titulado «Cuando la lluvia recuerda a España los límites de sus estadios», Le360 , el digital marroquí más afín a Mohamed VI, critica a nuestro país al decir que España «repite que posee las mejores infraestructuras» y que «la lluvia se ha encargado de recordar que los dos principales escaparates españoles también presentan algunas grietas» . Aquí suman al Santiago Bernabéu por unas pequeñas goteras que ocurrieron hace ya años. «Marruecos levanta el Gran Estadio Hassan II, un recinto de 115.000 espectadores destinado a convertirse en uno de los estadios de fútbol más grandes del mundo. El proyecto de nuestro país avanza con una ambición manifiesta : disponer de un estadio capaz de responder a las máximas exigencias de una final de la Copa del Mundo y rivalizar directamente con los dos gigantes españoles», reconocen en este diario. Las burlas contra España mezclando Ceuta y el Mundial 2030 Por otro lado, ese digital también se mofa de España en un artículo publicado « Mundial 2030: el caos español» , mezclando esa pelea por albergar la final con lo que ocurre en Ceuta, a la que llaman, como siempre, «ocupada». Recogiendo las declaraciones de Rafael Louzán , presidente de la Federación Española de Fútbol, que ha dicho en varias ocasiones que la final tiene que ser en España (como es lógico), este digital afín al régimen marroquí se burla de España. «¿Harán un gran estadio en la Ceuta ocupada?» , se preguntan, mientras añaden que es «una ciudad que ni siquiera dispone de un recinto que responda a las exigencias de la Primera División». Esto, además de suponer una manipulación total , es evidentemente una mofa a España, toda vez que Ceuta aquí nada tiene que ver, ya que ni es sede ni sub-sede del Mundial 2030. Le360 critica que en España están hablando y que «la final del Mundial no se gana a golpe de declaraciones, sino que se prepara con estadios, infraestructuras y garantías». Y es ahí donde ensalzan el proyecto del Gran Estadio Hasan II de Casablanca, que contará con 115.000 espectadores y está previsto que esté finalizado en 2028.

title_original: UFP arremete contra Marlaska por el expediente a los policías agredidos por el ultra del Barça: «Absolutamente inaceptable»
body_original: La Unión Federal de Policía (UFP) ha mostrado «su más absoluto rechazo» a la apertura de expediente «por falta muy grave» por parte del Ministerio del Interior a los agentes que fueron agredidos por un ultra independentista del Barcelona antes del encuentro de Liga ante el Elche. «Los policías afectados continúan sin haber recibido comunicación oficial y han tenido que conocer a través de los medios de comunicación que el ministro del Interior da por superada esa fase y anuncia ahora la incoación de un expediente disciplinario por una posible falta grave o muy grave», explican en un comunicado. Además, denuncian que la forma de actuar del Ministerio del Interior es «absolutamente inaceptable» : «Resulta especialmente sorprendente que Fernando Grande-Marlaska, que desarrolló durante décadas su carrera como juez y magistrado y llegó a presidir la Sala de lo Penal de la Audiencia Nacional, olvide ahora principios tan elementales como las garantías procedimentales, el derecho de defensa y el respeto debido a cualquier persona sometida a una investigación». «Un policía no puede levantarse por la mañana y descubrir en la prensa que su ministro ya ha anunciado públicamente un procedimiento que puede afectar gravemente a su carrera profesional , a su economía y a su vida personal, sin haber recibido previamente una sola comunicación oficial», añaden desde la Unión Federal de Policía. « Eso no es proteger las garantías de los policías . Es exactamente lo contrario», continúan. Desde UFP no piden «impunidad» para nadie : «Pedimos algo mucho más sencillo: respeto al procedimiento, a la presunción de inocencia y al derecho de defensa. Si existen hechos que deban investigarse, que se investiguen. Si existen responsabilidades acreditadas, que se depuren. Pero lo que no podemos aceptar es que la carrera profesional de unos policías se convierta en un anuncio político ante los medios antes incluso de que ellos sepan oficialmente qué se les imputa», explican.

title_original: El Atlético se vuelve a desconectar contra el Liverpool
body_original: El Liverpool ha conseguido remontar al Atlético de Madrid en Anfield . Los reds tuvieron que reponerse al tanto de Marcos Llorente en el minuto 14. El equipo supo medir los tiempos de partido y consiguió ponerse por delante con dos goles de Szoboszlai y Mac Allister . Simeone no consiguió dar con la tecla en la segunda parte, aunque hubo algunas opciones en los últimos minutos. Los colchoneros tuvieron muchos problemas para adueñarse de la posesión en la zona de tres cuartos. La presencia de Julián Álvarez en el once inicial se llevó todos los focos en la previa del encuentro. El argentino comenzó muy activo y consiguió rematar a puerta en los primeros cinco minutos. Las sensaciones mejoraron con una asistencia clave para que el lateral abriera el marcador en el minuto 17. El delantero se fue creciendo y estuvo muy cerca anotar con un disparo desde fuera del área. Llorente volvió a demostrar que cada vez que pisa Anfield se transforma, se convierte en futbolista que más goles le ha metido al Liverpool en Anfield en Champions League . El español aprovechó una gran asistencia del argentino, que le dejó solo ante Allison. El tanto que fue clave en un primer momento, pero el equipo no consiguió mostrar la misma versión en el segundo tiempo. La respuesta de los reds no tardó en llegar. Szoboszlai consiguió pescar un balón dentro del área después de una gran intervención de Oblak. Los locales consiguieron el empate a las puertas del descanso, un tanto que reflejaba la igualdad del juego en ese momento, ambos equipos habían rematado a puerta en tres ocasiones. Mac Allister culminó la remontada con un gran remate lejano. Mac Allister expone uno de los mayores problemas del Atlético de Madrid Simeone necesita ajustar algunos detalles en su esquema de juego. El equipo ha sufrido mucho con el marcador en contra, ya que no estaban siendo capaces de mantener la posesión ni forzar errores con una presión alta . Los cambios tampoco fueron efectivos, de hecho, con un rendimiento muy dudoso de Grimaldo que sigue sin ofrecer su mejor versión.

title_original: Flick elige a Lamine Yamal por delante de Rodri en el Balón de Oro: «Creo que se lo merece»
body_original: El FC Barcelona ha montado otra fiesta de goles en el Camp Nou. El equipo ha ganado 5-1 al Feyenoord en su primer partido de Champions. Hansi Flick se mostró muy satisfecho en rueda de prensa, aunque no dudó en mojarse respecto al Balón de Oro . Lamine Yamal y Rodri son dos de los favoritos para llevarse el reconocimiento. El alemán piensa que el extremo debería ganarlo: «Es especial. Nadie tiene esto como él. Creo que se lo merece . Creo que se lo merece». Las declaraciones del entrenador no dejan lugar a dudas. Sin embargo, teniendo en cuenta el rendimiento de ambos jugadores en el Mundial , el ex del City debería estar por delante, ya que fue nombrado MVP de la competición . Sin embargo, el técnico no puede ocultar su admiración por el canterano culé: «Para mí, es un jugador extraordinario . Puedes verlo en cada partido». El equipo blaugrana está siendo una apisonadora en el inicio de la temporada, con 15 goles en los últimos tres partidos . Flick destaca la mentalidad de la plantilla antes de medirse al Feyenoord: «Jugamos en Valencia, el siguiente entrenamiento fue uno de los mejores que he visto en mi vida. Esto es lo que necesitamos . Esta es la actitud, la mentalidad que necesitamos en cada entrenamiento y puedo verlo en este momento». La variedad de tantos también es una buena noticia para el vestuario, ya que todas las estrellas y fichajes están teniendo sus momentos destacados. El entrenador agradece la ambición de sus jugadores: « Esta es una gran situación porque esta intensidad que tenemos es la que necesitamos. Para nuestra filosofía, es lo más importante, la intensidad. También cómo presionamos y, por supuesto, como equipo. Y esto es lo más positivo que veo , que todos están incluidos». Flick se mantiene cauto con ‘la sexta’ El alemán sabe que la afición culé tiene la Champions entre ceja y ceja . Estos últimos años han sido muy esperanzadores para el equipo, pero no han conseguido llegar a la final. El técnico señala que tienen el nivel suficiente para cumplir con el objetivo: «Estamos al principio de la temporada y sé, y vosotros también lo sabéis, que hay un largo, largo camino hasta el final. Creo que podemos hacerlo ».

title_original: Mauricio Pochettino reveals Tottenham mistake in talks to reappoint him as manager
body_original: Mauricio Pochettino has revealed he will always be open to returning to Tottenham Hotspur as manager. However, the club have only ever made contact with him when he is unavailable. Pochettino has revealed timing has prevented him from returning to Spurs Getty Pochettino spent five years in charge of the north London outfit between 2014 and 2019. During that time, he achieved five successive top five finishes including two third places and a runner-up spot in the Premier League . Spurs’ second place finish under Pochettino in 2017 remains their highest league position for 63 years. He also guided the club to the final of both the League Cup and the Champions League. Of his 293 matches as manager across all competitions, Pochettino collected 160 wins at a win rate of 54.6 per cent. Only three permanent managers in the club’s 144-year history have had a higher win percentage. Why did Pochettino not return to Spurs? However, Pochettino was denied a return to the club last season due to his existing commitments with the USA. Having been appointed in 2024, he was preparing for their World Cup campaign when Spurs approached him to come back to the club. Pochettino explained: “If I were free, I would have gone back to Tottenham. “Even in the Championship. Whatever the division. Another club, no, but Tottenham, yes, of course. It’s the only club I’m always open to help.” Pochettino oversaw three successive top three finishes and a run to the Champions League final with Spurs Getty Spurs avoided relegation from the Premier League by just two points last season thanks to a final day victory over Everton . Roberto De Zerbi was appointed as manager in April, securing survival by picking up 11 points from the final seven matches. It could have easily been Pochettino in charge for the relegation run-in, though, with the Argentinian adding: “The problem was the timings were never the best. “When I was free, I never received a contact and then when I was working, I received a contact and then I couldn’t make the decision to come back. “It was a little bit unlucky. Maybe one day the stars will align and it will happen.” Pochettino’s post-Spurs career Pochettino instead went on to lead the USA to the last 16 of this summer’s World Cup, which they co-hosted with Canada and Mexico. Pochettino signed a new four-year deal with the USA national team in August Getty Although his deal had expired at the end of the tournament, he signed a new contract last month. The 54-year-old will now remain in charge through to the 2030 World Cup. Prior to moving into international management, Pochettino has had spells with both Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea since his Spurs exit. He spent 18 months as PSG boss following his appointment in January 2021. During that time, Pochettino won both the Ligue 1 title and the French Cup with his former side. Meanwhile, his Chelsea tenure lasted just one season, with the Blues finishing sixth in the 2023/24 season. Pochettino made headlines on Thursday for saying Tottenham should be awarded Chelsea’s 2016/17 Premier League title .
